Orange, California  

**Work Shift**

Day – 08hrs (United States of America)  
  

**Why RCH?**

At RCH, we strive to be the leading destination of children’s health by providing exceptional and innovative care. We are responsible for the overall health of our community’s pediatric population in our hospitals, clinics, and practices. And because of our breadth of care, your career at RCH can be as diverse and fulfilling as you determine. RCH’s compensation structure, benefits offerings, and career development programs are geared to helping you achieve your professional and personal goals. The Coordinator, Special Projects is responsible for working collaboratively across all facets of the department to provide project coordination for business and clinical programs and services, including initiatives focused on program growth, clinical excellence, and operational excellence. jobs.title: Asset/Move Coordinator - Relocation Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join Cordoba Corporation, a leading civil engineering, program/project management, construction management firm in California. We are seeking for an Asset/Move Coordinator (Relocation Project Manager) to join the Facilities Sector. This position supports the Relocation Project Management (RPM) team at multiple campuses as needed in furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) activities for all new, renovated and swing space projects which includes assistance in programming, specification, budget tracking, procurement coordination, scheduling with the construction team, installation, and punch list activities. Supports the RPM team in move management activities relating to move scope creation, bidding, analysis of bids, budget tracking, move coordination and scheduling, onsite move oversight and punch list activities to ensure complete functional occupancy of new and renovated buildings.

  

* Support the Furniture/Equipment/Relocation Project Management Services with emphasis in FF&E selection, procurement coordination and purchasing for all such areas as identified by the District to provide college the onsite FF&E and move-in/relocations management services.
* Responsibilities include strategic oversight of all FF&E procurement, FF&E Installation, pre-move, move, and post move/closeout phase activities for specified assigned projects.
* Services shall be provided at the direction of the College Project Director (CPD) and the Manager of Relocation Project Management team.
* Assist with the procurement and purchasing of FF&E using best-value and/or low bid public contracting.
* Support budget and schedule tracking efforts for FF&E and moves, and meet with relevant project architects (A/E), project managers, and BUGs, to be able to prepare office layouts and work with the occupants to plan furniture and equipment relocation of existing to the move location.
* Work with vendors and/or movers to assist with filling in equipment and furnishings where there are gaps.
* Coordinate and prepare a list of all new furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist with the timely and successful onsite FF&E installation, punch-list sign-off and transition during swing space, relocation and/or move into new buildings.
* Support the procurement of specialty contractors or movers for installations, delivery, and/or connections not covered by the FF&E vendors. Create detailed scope of work for Task Orders for Contractors/Movers as necessary.
* Support the RPM in the working with the project interior designer and the BUG user groups to select and prepare a list of all furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist in the onsite unlocking of all areas requiring access by the movers and others during the pre-move, move, installation and post move/closeout phases and for re-securing all such areas.
* Assist in the onsite coordination of all furniture and equipment deliveries with PMs, CPDs, facility directors, and BUGs if applicable; work closely with Asset Management Team to coordinate all asset tagging and disposition requirements, and Warranty Program Managers and other members of program staff working towards closeout of projects.
* Maintain all FF&E, move management, moving and storage related documents, including proposals, purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices and submit to the CPD in written form.

**Minimum Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma
* 1 year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations, Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawings
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement
* Strong written and oral communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Attention to detail
* Ability to be onsite at multiple colleges
* Proficiency Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software
* Flexibility in schedule and transportation to work at multiple locations based on assigned schedule.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4 year Degree in the areas of Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction/Project Management, Facilities Management or related area required.
* Procurement, sourcing or asset management experience
* Public Works experience
* Knowledge/proficiency in AutoCAD software
* Certification/Membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, LEED

Salary Range: $38.00 - $44.00/hourly  
Location: Monterey Park, CA  
Work Environment: Onsite

jobs.title: Production Assistant & Branded Live Ops Coordinator (TikTok Shop)
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Platinum Commerce, LLC is a leading e-commerce and social commerce agency that partners with top-tier brands to accelerate their growth on TikTok Shop, Amazon, Walmart, and other digital marketplaces. As a certified TikTok Shop Partner (TSP), we provide end-to-end solutions including shop management, affiliate marketing, live streaming operations, content strategy, and fulfillment services. Our team of e-commerce experts has driven millions in GMV for our clients, working with brands across beauty, consumer electronics, fashion, health & wellness, and home goods.

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a hands-on Production Assistant who can run the technical side of our live shopping streams and also keep the operation organized behind the scenes. You’ll set up, run, and troubleshoot live broadcasts across TikTok Shop. You’ll also manage stream schedules and own the run of show for each session, working closely with our Head of Live Commerce, hosts, account managers, and our Live Ops team. This role is ideal for someone who understands what it takes to make a branded live stream happen.

**Responsibilities**

**Live Production**

* Set up and break down live streaming equipment (cameras, lighting, audio, capture devices) for each session
* Run live production during streams, including camera operation, switching, audio levels, and on-screen product and graphics support
* Create TikTok LIVE sticker overlays and on-screen graphics (promo callouts, pricing, flash deals, countdowns) and implement them into the stream through TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS, or similar tools
* Monitor stream health in real time and troubleshoot technical issues as they arise
* Manage product staging and on-set organization so items are ready for each segment

**Scheduling**

* Build and maintain the live stream calendar across brands and platforms
* Schedule hosts and production crew for each session and handle last-minute changes or call-outs

**Run of Show & Stream Coordination**

* Build and maintain the run of show for each stream, including segments, product order, promos, and timing
* Coordinate with hosts, producers, account managers, and brand partners before each stream so everyone is aligned on the plan
* Keep the stream on track in real time, cueing hosts and adjusting the run of show as needed
* Confirm products, samples, and overlay assets are ready before going live

**Requirements**

* Background in live streaming or live commerce production, with direct TikTok Shop LIVE experience required (eBay Live or Whatnot experience is a plus)
* Hands-on experience creating and adding sticker overlays and on-screen graphics to TikTok LIVE streams
* Comfortable operating streaming and production equipment (cameras, switchers, mics, lighting)
* Experience managing schedules or coordinating live productions with multiple people
* Highly organized with strong follow-through and clear communication
* Calm under pressure and able to multitask during live, real-time broadcasts
* Reliable availability for scheduled shifts, including occasional evenings or weekends
* Detail-oriented, punctual, and able to take direction quickly in a fast-paced environment

**Location:** Beverly Hills, CA

**Pay:** $30.00 - $48.00 per hour

Pay: $30.00 - $48.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Do you have prior experience with live commerce platforms (TikTok Shop, eBay Live, Whatnot, etc.)?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Temporary Administrative Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  
  
To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

Responsibilities:

Job duties include, but are not limited to:

* Process travel reimbursements, purchase orders, and monitor tracking balances to maintain accurate financial records.
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, and IT/badge access setup for faculty, advanced practice providers, clinical observers, and student researchers.
* Coordinate faculty interview schedules, itineraries, meeting logistics, and review or organize administrative files.
* Manage academic personnel actions, including merit and promotion processes, while keeping provider profiles and public-facing information current.

* High school diploma or equivalent experience with administrative support in a professional office environment.
* Demonstrated ability to schedule complex meetings, coordinate interview itineraries, and organize detailed file systems.
* Strong organizational skills to track balance accounts, review documentation, and handle sensitive personnel records accurately.
* Excellent communication skills to interact professionally with faculty, medical staff, and academic affiliates.

**Preferred:**

* Prior experience utilizing the Kuali Financial System (KFS) and UCI Buy+ procurement systems.
* Familiarity with academic merit and promotion procedures within a university or healthcare setting.
* Background in supporting healthcare provider credentialing or medical staff relations

**Total Rewards**

In addition to the salary range listed below, we offer a wealth of benefits to make working at UCI even more rewarding. These benefits may include medical insurance, sick and vacation time, retirement savings plans, and access to a number of discounts and perks. Please utilize the links listed here to learn more about our compensation practices and benefits.

**Pay Rate:** $30.87/hour

* Background Check and Live Scan
* Employment Misconduct\*

* Drug Free Environment

The following additional conditions may apply, some of which are dependent upon business unit or job specific requirements.

* California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act
* E-Verify
* Pre-Placement Health Evaluation

Details of each policy may be reviewed by visiting the following page - https://hr.uci.edu/new-hire/conditions-of-employment.php

**Temporary Employment**

Interviewing and hiring is based on internal hiring needs and how well the candidate's experience matches the assignment requirements. Certain temporary assignments may require clearance of a health physical or require a valid California Driver’s License for driving university vehicles.

jobs.title: Client Experience Concierge (CEC) & Marketing Coordinator [Part-Time]
jobs.description:
**[Part-Time] Client Experience Concierge & Marketing Coordinator**

The Client Experience Concierge & Marketing Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for clients, guests, advisors, and visitors while providing administrative, operational, and marketing support to the office. This position is responsible for creating a welcoming, professional, and exceptional client experience at the Client Experience Center while also supporting the office’s marketing initiatives, communications, and business development activities.

The ideal candidate is a **highly motivated, organized, proactive, and detail-oriented self-starter** who thrives in a fast-paced environment. This individual must possess a strong sense of urgency, excellent follow-through, and the ability to effectively balance front-desk responsibilities with marketing projects and administrative priorities.

**While this position includes significant marketing and project coordination responsibilities, the Client Experience Center remains the primary responsibility of the role, and the successful candidate must be comfortable balancing front-desk coverage and client-facing responsibilities with marketing and administrative projects.**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Client Experience Center/Reception**

* Responsible for overseeing the operational workflow of the Client Experience Center (CEC)
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, guests, and visitors
* Greet visitors and provide a warm, professional client experience
* Assist with conference room scheduling, adding guests to building security list, and guest parking validations
* Responsible for maintaining all office supply and Client Experience Center inventory
* Inspect the office space weekly and order necessary repairs or recommend replacement when necessary
* Responsible for all incoming and outgoing mail and daily client check processing
* Responsible for assisting with office event planning including quarterly leadership offsites, annual holiday party, and special community engagement projects
* Daily & Monthly reporting including and not limited to: Parking validations, postage usage, printing usage, and monthly spending, new client business submittal to Home Office partners
* Liaison between office and building management in addition to key leadership
* Establish systems and processes to be implemented across district office in Southern California, Nevada
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with teams in a fast-paced environment

**Marketing & Project Coordination**

* Support the planning and execution of client events and marketing initiatives
* Coordinate event logistics, invitations, materials, communications, and follow-up
* Assist with presentations, social media, newsletters, and other marketing materials
* Maintain marketing calendars, project timelines, and related materials
* Coordinate with advisors, staff, and vendors to support successful project execution
* Support special projects and initiatives as assigned
* Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism
* Other duties as assigned

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* College-educated, Bachelors preferred
* 2+ years of experience in reception, client service, administrative support, marketing, or a related field
* Extremely organized, detail-oriented, resilient, responsible, and resourceful
* Disciplined, ambitious and motivated by growth opportunities within the firm
* Someone who thrives in a deadline driven environment where results are rewarded
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Capable of coming into the office 5 days a week
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; marketing, social media, or Canva experience preferred
* Frequently moves boxes weighing up to 35 pounds across the office for various needs
* Experience with pivot tables, excel spreadsheet

**BENEFITS:**

We believe in creating a work environment that supports long-term career growth. Accordingly, we provide a rewarding compensation package that includes:

* A competitive base salary commensurate to experience
* Employer-sponsored licensing, professional development, and education opportunities
* Parking/transportation stipend
* High-impact and dynamic career path

Northwestern Mutual – West Los Angeles is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate or tolerate harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Client & Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Lark Los Angeles is a floral and event design studio known for large Jewish weddings and celebrations in Los Angeles. We work with families and high-profile clients who trust us with personal details. We’re hiring one full-time coordinator to work alongside our founder, Simcha, in our studio in the Beverly Hills area of Los Angeles and at local events. This position is in person only.**

You’ll be the person a client calls when their guest count changes or they want to see a floral sample. You’ll get them an answer, update the plan, and make sure the design team, venue, and vendors know what changed.

What you’ll do

* Answer calls and emails, gather event details and budgets, and schedule consultations and floral sample meetings.

* Get pricing from vendors, revise proposals and invoices, and follow up on client decisions and signatures.

* Keep floor plans and timelines current. Confirm deliveries, setup times, insurance paperwork, and vendor agreements.

* Coordinate with the team on event days, flag conflicts early, and follow through until each issue is resolved.

What we’re looking for

You communicate clearly in spoken and written English, handle private client details with discretion, and can manage several deadlines without losing track of a promise. You’re comfortable speaking with clients and vendors and learning the customs and timing of Jewish celebrations. Experience in client service, hospitality, or events is welcome.

Pay and schedule

$60,000–$80,000 per year, plus additional pay for extra hours worked. On non-event days, office hours are 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Event days can run longer and frequently fall on weekends. When you work a weekend, you receive a day off during the week.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Event Coordinator – Rise Together 5K (Contract)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Torrance, CA (race day on site; planning can be partly remote)  
**Pay:** $1,500 flat rate for the event  
**Job type:** Contract, part-time

**About the event**

The Rise Together 5K Run & Walk is a first-year community race on **Sunday, May 23, 2027**, at Charles H. Wilson Park in Torrance. It’s co-hosted by two nonprofits:

* **Mass Liberation** works with empathy and love to address the harms of incarceration, educating and empowering returning citizens through evidence-based, whole-person approaches.
* **New Skin Tattoo Removal** is a 501(c)(3) that provides low-cost tattoo removal to people held back from gainful employment.

Proceeds support reentry services and tattoo removal. The race has a goal of up to 500 runners and walkers, plus a sponsor and resource village where local businesses and reentry service providers will set up booths.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and manage the event timeline from now through race day.
* Coordinate City of Torrance permits with the Special Events & Filming Office and Community Services, plus the event insurance certificate.
* Book and manage vendors: chip timing, race shirts, portable toilets, signage, a sound system, water and post-race food.
* Plan race-day logistics for a loop course: measuring the course, the start/finish area, the water station, lap counting and course marshals.
* Recruit, schedule and brief volunteers.
* Lay out the sponsor and resource village and coordinate booth setup.
* Run race day from setup through teardown, and handle problems as they come up.
* Track the budget and send a short wrap-up report after the event.

**What we’re looking for**

* **Required:** experience coordinating a 5K or other road race, **or** a strong record coordinating community events of 200+ people.
* Experience working with city permits, vendors and insurance requirements.
* Experience recruiting and leading volunteers.
* Organized and dependable, with clear communication and calm problem-solving on event day.
* Available for the full day on Sunday, May 23, 2027, and for setup the day before.
* Reliable transportation to Torrance.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with race registration and timing platforms such as RunSignup.
* Familiarity with South Bay vendors and venues.
* A connection to reentry, workforce or community nonprofit work.

**Compensation**

$1,500 flat rate for the full event, covering planning, race day and wrap-up.

**To apply:** submit your resume along with a short note describing a race or event you coordinated: its size, your role and how it went.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Torrance, CA 90501

* Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced work environment

* Bachelor’s Degree, preferred
* Minimum 3 years’ experience in retail marketing

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager / Adoption Strategist
jobs.description:
**About Quilter**
=================

At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal.

No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there:

* Curiosity
* Conviction
* Rigor

### **About the Role**

This role is a critical, high-impact link between Quilter's AI platform and our enterprise hardware engineering customers. You will serve as both a deep technical expert in workflow integration and a strategic catalyst—driving customer onboarding, tool adoption, expansion, and long-term retention across top-tier enterprise accounts in aerospace, defense, consumer electronics, and robotics. The ideal candidate uncovers blockers to adoption and builds alignment with customer goals to make PCB design more efficient.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Drive Adoption & Usage:** Lead recurring weekly customer engagement calls and onboarding programs to guide layout specialists, electrical engineers, and engineering managers through PCB design submission, routing analysis, and workflow integration.
* **Manage Pilots & Expansion:** Shepherd early-stage commercial engagements and paid pilot programs into broad, sustained enterprise deployments across major accounts.
* **Monitor Engagement Metrics:** Track account health and design submission metrics using internal tools like HubSpot and Airtable to proactively identify blockers and scale usage.
* **Technical Support & Diagnostics:** Analyze design failures, Design Rule Check (DRC) flags, and placement/routing bottlenecks on complex boards (e.g., high-speed digital, RF, high-power).
* **Voice of the Customer:** Synthesize customer challenges and edge cases into actionable product requirements for Quilter's engineering teams.

### **Requirements:**

* **Technical Background:** ~7+ years of total professional experience, ideally blending ~2–3 years in hands-on electrical engineering / PCB design and ~4–5 years in customer-facing technical roles.
* **Nice-to-Have ECAD Expertise:** Hands-on familiarity with enterprise ECAD suites—specifically Cadence Allegro or Siemens Xpedition—is highly preferred but not strictly required.
* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* **Working Location & Travel:** In-office presence 3–4 days per week with 30%+ travel for key customer visits and on-site deployment workshops.
* **Compensation:** $200,000 – $250,000 base salary per year with a 20% – 30% performance bonus structure and equity grant package.

**Please note**: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent.

**What we offer:**
==================

* Interesting and challenging work
* Competitive salary and equity benefits
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Regular team events and offsites (~4x / year)
* Unlimited paid time off
* Paid parental leave

Want to learn more about Quilter, our vision, and our investors? Visit our About page and visit our Blog.

**ABOUT HEAVISIDE INDUSTRIES**

Heaviside Industries builds multi-domain autonomous precision munitions for U.S. and allied special operations and conventional forces. While modern warfare has rapidly evolved with the proliferation of unmanned systems, hyper-precise munitions in contested environments are the future of the battlefield. Economical precision strike capabilities are critical to U.S. and allied war efforts, enabling successful defeat of enemy military assets and infrastructure. Heaviside builds precision munitions designed to operate in GPS-denied and spectrum-jammed battlefields—where traditional systems degrade or fail—without inflated prices or sacrifice to performance.

All engineering and manufacturing is conducted in-house in Heaviside's Los Angeles, CA headquarters and Oslo, Norway office.

Heaviside is backed by Interlagos, Menlo Ventures, Flume Ventures, Cantos, Anorak Ventures, and Ravelin Ventures.

The Role

As Sales Operations Coordinator, you will keep our quoting process accurate and our records clean, so that every order moves smoothly from Business Development to Accounting. You'll prepare and track customer quotes, check incoming purchase orders against what we quoted, and make sure Accounting has complete, organized documentation for invoicing and reconciliation.

This is an early-career role with real responsibility. You'll work closely with our Business Development and Finance teams, correspond directly with customers on quotes and order details, and learn how a fast-growing defense manufacturer turns a customer request into a delivered order.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

**Quoting**

* Prepare price quotes using standard templates, based on input from the Business Development team and company pricing guidelines.
* Revise quotes as customers or BD request changes, and keep version history clear and easy to follow.
* Route quotes for internal review and approval before they go to customers.

**Customer Correspondence**

* Send quotes to customers and serve as a point of contact for questions about pricing, terms, and quote revisions.
* Confirm order details with customers when a purchase order arrives, and follow up on missing or unclear information.
* Keep communication professional, accurate, and timely, and loop in BD when a question needs their input.

**Purchase Orders & Accounting Handoff**

* Check every incoming purchase order (PO) against the quoted price, quantities, and terms, and flag any differences before it moves forward.
* Enter approved POs into our ERP / order management system.
* Package quote, PO, and order documentation for Accounting so invoicing and reconciliation go smoothly.
* Answer Accounting's questions about quotes and orders, and resolve discrepancies with BD and customers.

**Records & Reporting**

* Maintain an organized, audit-ready record of all quotes, revisions, POs, and customer correspondence.
* Track open quotes and pending orders, and share regular status updates with BD and Finance.
* Help improve quoting templates and processes as the business scales.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
---------------------------

* 0–2 years of experience in sales support, sales operations, customer service, administrative, or accounting support roles. Internships and part-time roles count.
* A bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Exceptional attention to detail. Accuracy in quotes, POs, and records is the heart of this job.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication, and confidence corresponding directly with customers.
* Comfort with spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets), including basic formulas, sorting, and filtering.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to keep several open quotes and orders on track at once.
* Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow with a fast-moving team.
* U.S. Person as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.62).

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Exposure to an ERP or order management system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Odoo) or a CRM.
* Experience preparing quotes, invoices, or purchase orders.
* Familiarity with basic accounting concepts such as invoicing, accounts receivable, or reconciliation.
* Interest in aerospace, defense, government contracting, or advanced manufacturing.

**Additional Information:**

Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here: https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc\_kb\_article\_page&sys\_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987

jobs.description:
Marketing Manager – Physical Therapy & Wellness

**Rausch Physical Therapy & Wellness**

**Location:** Laguna Niguel, CA 92677

**Job Type:** Full-Time | In-Person

Rausch Physical Therapy & Wellness is a growing, well-established healthcare and wellness company serving Orange County. We are passionate about helping our community move better, feel better, and live healthier lives.

With multiple locations throughout Orange County, we offer a variety of services, including physical therapy, sports performance, massage therapy, Stretch Fix, chiropractic care, pelvic health, and wellness programs.

jobs.title: Account Manager, VaaS (Vault-as-a-Service)
jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  
  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  
  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  
  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

  

We’re looking for an ***Account Manager, VaaS*** who will run a large book of smaller and newer Vault-as-a-Service (VaaS) partners. You'll get them to live fast on a standard playbook, keep them healthy and spot the ones ready to grow. You're accountable for each account's revenue and retention.

  

*What VaaS is:*

PSA Vault stores graded cards for their owners. Vault-as-a-Service (VaaS) lets other companies build on it. Marketplaces, live-commerce apps, pack and break platforms, games and fantasy apps, fintechs and retailers use our APIs to store cards, transfer ownership between their customers and ship cards to a customer's door. They get vaulting and fulfillment without building a warehouse. The program went live in 2026, and new partners signed most weeks.

  

*Your book:*

You'll manage smaller partners on our standard rate card, plus new partners until they scale, across every part of the hobby. Expect many accounts, a light touch on each and repeatable launches. Your starting book is set when you join and rebalanced each quarter.

  

You’ll report to the *General Manager, VaaS* . ***Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered.*** ***We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.***

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Fast, standard launches.** Take each account from BD at signature, run the handoff and get the partner live on our standard onboarding playbook with as little custom work as possible.
* **Onboarding playbook.** Improve the onboarding playbook, self-serve materials and partner documentation as you go, so launches take less time.
* **Revenue and renewals.** Own revenue, renewals and expansion for your book within our standard pricing. Keep a health score for every partner.
* **Contract terms.** Know each account's pricing, minimums and SLAs, and hold both sides to them.
* **Forecasting.** Flag partner launches and campaigns to Vault Operations early, with a volume estimate.
* **Escalations.** Own the partner side of every issue: triage, updates and the SLA clock. Vault Operations, Product and Support fix the problem; you make sure it gets fixed and keep the partner informed.
* **Moving accounts up.** When a partner outgrows the standard tier, hand it to a Senior AM with an account plan.
* **Coverage.** Cover the Senior AMs' accounts during absences and peak periods.

*What you won't own:*

* Prospecting and closing new partners. BD does that.
* Billing and collections. Finance runs them; you own invoice accuracy and step in when an account falls behind.
* Fixing operational issues. Vault Operations does; you own the partner side.
* Custom deals. Anything outside standard terms goes to a Senior AM or the GM.

*Your first 90 days:*

* **Days 1–30:** learn the vault end to end (intake, imaging, ownership transfer, withdrawal, claims). Shadow the Senior AMs. Take over your book with a handoff on every account.
* **Days 31–60:** launch your first partners on the standard playbook. Put a health score on every account.
* **Days 61–90:** ship one improvement to the playbook or partner docs that cuts launch time. Flag the first accounts ready to move up a tier.

*What a typical week looks like:*

* Kickoffs and launch check-ins with new partners
* Answering partner questions in Slack and email, and routing issues to the right team
* Health-score review across your book
* Account notes in the CRM and a weekly update to the GM

*How we'll measure success:*

* Partners launched per quarter, and time from signature to first revenue
* Net and gross revenue retention for your book
* Accounts moved up a tier
* Overdue receivables

*Who you'll work with:*

Senior Account Managers, Business Development, VaaS Product & Engineering, Vault Operations, PSA Offers and Finance.

  

**Who You Are:**

*Required Qualifications:*

* 3–5 years in account management, customer success, partner operations or SaaS onboarding
* Experience running a high-volume book of B2B accounts (dozens at once)
* A clear writer who's comfortable with technical documentation and basic API concepts
* An eye for early signs that a partner is ready to grow or likely to leave
* You're skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) and use them to get more done: research an account, analyze us

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving customer problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and takes pride in delivering accurate, timely billing support. You'll work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure billing processes run smoothly while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through process enhancements and AI-powered tools.

**Position Summary**

As a Billing Operations Specialist, you will own the day-to-day execution of billing, collections, and account management activities. You will serve as a trusted resource for customers and internal teams by resolving billing inquiries, processing account changes, and ensuring the accuracy of financial transactions.

Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong customer service skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy. You'll also be encouraged to identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve the customer experience.

**Responsibilities**

**Billing Operations**

* Manage daily billing operations for subscription and customer accounts.
* Process new subscriptions, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, refunds, credits, and billing adjustments.
* Ensure invoices, payments, and account records are accurate and up to date.
* Reconcile billing discrepancies and proactively resolve account issues.
* Support month-end billing activities and revenue-related operational tasks.

**Customer Experience**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer billing inquiries and account-related questions.
* Resolve billing concerns professionally and efficiently while providing an exceptional customer experience.
* Communicate clearly with customers regarding invoices, payment options, subscription changes, and account status.
* Maintain ownership of customer issues through resolution, coordinating with internal teams as needed.

**Support Operations**

* Manage billing-related support tickets and ensure timely responses and resolutions.
* Prioritize work effectively while meeting service level expectations.
* Identify recurring customer issues and recommend process improvements.

**Fraud, Payments & Account Integrity**

* Review payment exceptions, chargebacks, disputes, and refund requests.
* Assist with fraud prevention efforts by identifying unusual account activity.
* Maintain accurate documentation related to payment investigations and account actions.

**Process Improvement**

* Continuously evaluate billing workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Identify repetitive tasks that can be streamlined through process improvements or AI-assisted tools.
* Create and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Partner with Customer Support, Finance, Engineering, and Operations teams to improve billing processes and customer experience.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2–3 years of experience in billing operations, customer support, customer success, finance operations, accounts receivable, or a related operational role.
* Experience supporting customers in a subscription, SaaS, technology, telecommunications, or service-based business.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.
* Experience working within ticketing or customer support platforms.

jobs.title: Inbound Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**What will you do?**

The primary responsibilities of the Inbound Logistics Coordinator are to proactively monitor, expedite, and measure the import/export flows from sourced vendor freight for their assigned region(s) and brand(s). Accountabilities also include regular meetings with logistics 3PL providers, carriers, as well as with internal business partners within the brands and distribution centers in the assigned region(s).

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

The Inbound Logistics Coordinator will monitor the flow of inbound air, ocean, and truck freight to the distribution network for the assigned region(s). Responsible for ensuring correct carriers are used, dwell time is minimized at various stages of the supply chain, and proactive communication of status of expedited freight to key stakeholders on a regular cadence. Responsible to make sure applicable systems (Infor Nexus, SAP, etc) are updated with relevant dates and milestones as movement of freight occurs within the supply chain. Coordinator will produce and present basic KPIs to measure logistics provider performance and will be accountable to recommend improvements or changes to business process to achieve target lead times and costs.

  

**Logistics Strategy**

* Engage with business partners in developing strategies related to cost, speed, and service.
* Collaborate with logistics team, carriers, and other business partners to develop, design, and implement logistics cost management and customer service enhancement strategies.
* Foster and develop strong relationships with logistics and transportation partners.

***\*******Please Note:*** ***Uprite Construction is not accepting resumes from third-party agencies for this position. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Uprite Construction's property, and no fees will be paid for unsolicited referrals.\****

  

Are you an experienced Assistant Project Manager who is ready to take on more responsibility and grow into a Project Manager role?

Uprite Construction is looking for a motivated Assistant Project Manager with experience in ground up commercial construction and tenant improvement (TI) projects. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has built a solid foundation in construction project management and is ready to take the next step in their career.

We're specifically looking for someone who has the experience, drive, and potential to transition into a full Project Manager role within the next 6 to 12 months.

You'll work closely with experienced Project Managers and leadership, gain greater ownership of projects, and have the opportunity to develop the skills needed to independently manage projects from start to finish.

### **What You'll Do**

* Support the management of ground up commercial construction and tenant improvement projects from preconstruction through closeout.
* Work closely with Project Managers and Superintendents to keep projects on schedule, within budget, and moving forward.
* Assist with project budgets, cost tracking, forecasting, and financial reporting.
* Coordinate subcontractors, vendors, architects, engineers, and project stakeholders.
* Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, purchase orders, and project documentation.
* Assist with subcontractor buyout, contract administration, and procurement.
* Participate in project meetings and communicate regularly with clients and internal teams.
* Monitor construction schedules, identify potential challenges, and help resolve issues before they impact project delivery.
* Take increasing ownership of project responsibilities while preparing to independently manage projects.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in commercial construction, ideally as an Assistant Project Manager or Project Engineer with increasing project management responsibilities.
* Experience with both ground up commercial construction and tenant improvement projects.
* Solid understanding of construction methods, scheduling, budgeting, and project coordination.
* Experience working with subcontractors, vendors, and field teams.
* Familiarity with construction management software such as Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of responsibilities.
* Someone who is proactive, motivated, and genuinely interested in growing into a Project Manager position.
* A degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent construction experience will also be considered.

  

**About Us**

Uprite Construction was established in 1991 as a multi-service construction company specializing in project site development, ground-up, new construction, renovations, and tenant improvements for the commercial and industrial sectors. Check us out at upritecomgmt.com!  
  
We appreciate your interest in employment with Uprite Construction. Overview::

**Project Coordinator - HGA Community+Live, Workplace & Government Architecture Team!**

Location: **San Francisco, CA**

HGA is seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our Community + Live, Workplace & Government Architecture team in our San Francisco, CA. This role plays a key part in driving project success across all phases—from early design through documentation and construction.

The Project Coordinator independently manages tasks of moderate size and complexity while supporting project teams with strong communication, technical capability, and organizational skill. Working under general supervision, this role contributes to design development, coordinates with consultants, engages directly with clients, and assists in preparing critical project deliverables. The position also begins to take on mentorship responsibilities, helping guide junior staff and modeling sound judgment in both design and technical decision-making.

**In this role you will:**

**Design & Documentation**

  

* Independently develop architectural drawings, details, and design layouts.
* Conduct design analyses and planning studies to inform project direction.
* Prepare construction documents using Revit and AutoCAD with minimal oversight.
* Compile and analyze data to support design decisions and project goals.
* Assist in writing specifications and coordinating building systems.

**Project Coordination**

  

* Manage assigned portions of project scope, schedule, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with consultants and internal teams to ensure design alignment.
* Review submittals, RFIs, and drawings for compliance and clarity.
* Support construction administration through site visits and field reports.
* Maintain organized documentation and contribute to project records.

**Communication & Collaboration**

  

* Communicate effectively with Project Managers, Principals, and consultants.
* Participate in design meetings and contribute to collaborative problem-solving.
* Present ideas clearly and document decisions for team reference.
* Mentor junior staff and contribute to a culture of learning and accountability.

**Professional Growth**

  

* Continue developing expertise in codes, specifications, and construction processes.
* Seek opportunities to lead design tasks and contribute to project strategy.
* Expand proficiency in BIM workflows and project management tools.
* Demonstrate initiative, technical rigor, and a commitment to design excellence.

**What you will need to have:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in architecture from an accredited institution.
* 5–7 years of professional experience.
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Adobe Creative Suite, and Microsoft Office.
* Familiarity with BIM workflows and project management tools (e.g., VantagePoint).

**Salary Information:**

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short- and long-term disability programs. Salary Range: $84,000 - $92,000 **depending on qualifications and experience**.

**Additional Information:**

HGA is a place where you can do your best work. We believe that enduring, impactful design results from deep insight into the people and passions that animate each unique environment. We value empathy, are fueled by curiosity, and embrace the hard work that leads to innovation. Equally important is our commitment to creating a culture of inclusivity and diversity where we encourage your originality, respect the need for flexibility and work-life balance, and empower your desired career growth. HGA is a national award-winning interdisciplinary design firm rooted in architecture and engineering.

Learn more about us **here****.**

**Application Requirements & Instructions**  
Please submit resume and portfolio for consideration.

**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**  
  
The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

**Title:****Program Specialist (Inclusion Support)**

**Salary:****$26.00 - $30.00/hour**

**Reports to:****Site Coordinator**

**Status:****Part-Time (22.5 Hours/Week), Non-Exempt** **(Position Ends: June 2, 2027)**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION:**

Under the direction of the Site Coordinator, the Program Specialist is responsible for providing 1:1 and/or small group social and emotional support as well as behavioral intervention and coaching to school age children during after school programs and/or summer. Responsibilities also include the coordination of support services and communication with school day and afterschool staff and families.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide one-on-one and/or small group social and emotional support as well as behavioral coaching using positive reinforcement strategies to a caseload of school age children.
* Develop individualized care plans and document student progress.
* Work with individual students or small groups of students to guide and facilitate independent study, enrichment skill building, and make-up school work as necessary.
* Collaborate and coordinate with school day teachers, counselors, and after school staff to identify students who need specialized support for program participation.
* Participate in Student Support/Coordinated Care Team, IEP, SAP, or SST meetings as necessary.
* Maintain the confidentiality of student information and share data around intervention progress.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Make contact with parents/caregivers in a professional and consistent manner to advise parents on youths' progress and challenges.
* Assist with data entry, administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend ongoing training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by the supervisor and management team.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields preferred but must have completed a minimum of 48 college units or passed an Instructional Aide Exam.
* 2 years of proven experience in youth development, early childhood education, or work with special needs children.
* Possess empathy, understanding of children’s developmental stages, and knowledge in utilizing positive behavior management strategies.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with diverse youth and families is a plus.
* Must possess good organization, patience, communication (both oral and written) and teamwork skills.
* Capacity to multitask, work independently, and make sound decisions are a must.
* Good technology skills (familiar with Google docs & sheets, MS Office, etc.)
* Ability to model to staff and participants: professionalism, personal responsibility, a strong work ethic and positive character.
* Bilingual in Spanish and Cantonese/Mandarin, is a plus.

Program Coordinator (5156C), Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension (SSALLEX) is the extended education division of the University of California, Berkeley and an essential part of the University's mission to extend the research and scholarship of UC Berkeley to a global community.
  
  
SSALLEX is a vibrant and dynamic organization that enables more than 60,000 visiting UC and potential Cal students; parents, faculty, academic units, international business partners, and central campus service providers engage in campus activities. The department provides more than 2,000 summer courses, early-start programs, study abroad experiences, global internships, and year-around programs or courses, lectures, special events and interest circles for older adults.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Based on the continued growth and expansion of the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge program, the Program Coordinator is needed to support the execution and management of the program's operations. This position would work with the Director and would be responsible for applying advanced student services expertise and coordinating the academic advising, logistical, programmatic, and administrative operations of the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge summer program for newly admitted UC Berkeley students.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is November 23, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Apply full range of student support services to newly admitted students pursuing the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge program.
  
Provide on-going advising to prospective and matriculated students, families, and legal guardians and effectively manage a high volume of inquiries from prospective and matriculated students as well as campus and internal partners
  
Advise Director on university and program specific policies and procedures as well as program development, administration and general logistics.
  
Advise students on topics such as but not limited to eligibility requirements, opt-in/opt-out process, financial aid, academics, housing, support services, and resources for the course enrollment process.
  
Resolve student services-related issues and grievances during and after the course of the program, including course enrollment, billing, withdrawal/cancellation, appeals process, and other related inquiries.
  
Plan, implement and participate in virtual, local, domestic, and other outreach events and recruitment opportunities primarily in California as well as hosting and facilitating in-person and online outreach events, such as information sessions and pre-program webinars
  
Responsible for interpreting organization policies and advising students and faculty on student conduct, student grievances, disputes, and issues regarding discrimination.
  
Oversees and may conduct orientations of new students.
  
Plan and implement student programming, events and orientations aimed at equipping newly admitted first-year and transfer students with the knowledge to succeed during the course of the program and in their transition to UC Berkeley
  
Develops and enhances an alumni recruitment network. Including coordinating the recruitment, hiring, and training process of student staff including program assistants and program ambassadors
  
Support emergency and crisis management intervention
  
Maintain confidential conduct records as defined by FERPA, Clery, Title IX, and other regulations
  
Create, update, and maintain student databases and provide data insights and analysis when needed.
  
Develop and maintain program literature and resources, including program website and knowledge base, and maintain external and on-going communication to various constituents
  
Coordinating administrative and operational tasks including but not limited to making purchases, invoice and vendor payments, expense pre-approvals, and reimbursements
  
Evaluate short-term and long-term success of programs and make recommendations to changes in policy, practice, and procedure accordingly.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Working knowledge of advising and counseling techniques.
  
Skills in judgment and decision making, problem identification, problem-solving, reasoning.
  
Interpersonal skills and multicultural competencies; ability to work with diverse populations, including high school students, freshmen and transfer students.

jobs.title: MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office
jobs.description:
MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and providing space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Pla n, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The MPS Dean's Diversity Office initiates, implements, and evaluates efforts and conducts research on student, postdoc, and faculty success in the mathematical and physical science fields with an emphasis on ensuring fair access and equitable outcomes. The Assistant Dean and their staff organize new initiatives, develop new funding, and support departmental efforts to students, and receive all work duties directly from the Assistant Dean. Collaborates with professors, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, staff, and administrators from UCB and national partners.
  
  
Currently projects underway include MPS Scholars and the MPS Scholarship Program at the undergraduate level, a doctoral advancement program, and a postdoc study. This position is responsible for providing programmatic, administrative, and financial coordination for MPS Dean's Office. Provides support to the Assistant Dean. The Assistant Dean advises the Deans and Department Chairs, manages and provides assistance to several student organizations, conducts research, develops new programs, and works to enhance equity among the faculty, staff, and students in the MPS departments.
  
  
The position requires in-depth understanding of campus policies and administrative practices. The position holder is a key point of contact for all MPS Dean's Office business and must be able to work with a high degree of independence with good judgement and follow through.
  
  
MPS Scholars is the official student success and mentorship program of the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, offered collaboratively with the Departments of Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Open to all intended and declared MPS majors, MPS Scholars provides opportunities to build community, explore academic and career pathways, and thrive throughout the Berkeley experience.
  
  
Since launching in Fall 2022, thousands of students have participated in MPS Scholars through mentorship, events, workshops, and academic and career resources.
  
  
MPS Scholars is a structured program, supported by funding from the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation. It provides activities and opportunities such as: A supportive mentoring network of advanced students, faculty, professional scientists, and alumni. Welcome and orientation programs for incoming students. Research and internship opportunities in academic and industry settings. Career development workshops, courses, networking events, and graduate school preparation. Academic resources designed to support success in MPS majors. Retreats, social events, and community-building activities that connect students with peers, graduate mentors, staff, alumni, and faculty across the MPS departments.
  
  
The Mathematical and Physical Sciences Scholarship Program (MPSSP) awards up to $15,000 per year in scholarship support to eligible students in Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Funded by the National Science Foundation's S-STEM program, MPSSP scholars receive financial support while participating fully in the MPS Scholars community.
  
  
At the graduate level, a bridge grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation grant is focused on establishing a prototype for the establishment of a Sloan Center for Systemic Change (SCSC) at Berkeley by establishing a consortium of departments working together to advance their equity goals.
  
  
At the postdoctoral level, the Postdoc Study, supported by a grant from the Heising-Simons Foundation, is designed to provide a clearer understanding of the experiences of postdoctoral scholars and causes of patterns of career selection among postdocs in the MPS fields at top-tier universities and national research facilities.
  
  
The MPS Program Coordinator coordinates and administers academic support and student success programs within the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, including MPS Scholars and the NSF S-STEM Scholarship Program. The position supports the development and implementation of programs designed to enhance the academic, professional, and personal success of undergraduate and graduate students, with particular attention to students who may face barriers to academic success.
  
  
Working under the direction of the Assistant Dean and in collaboration with faculty, staff, students, and campus and external partners, the Program Coordinator provides programmatic support, coordinates mentoring and professional development activities, supports students in navigating academic and other challenges, and assists with program assessment and evaluation. The position also coordinates program communications and outreach, supervises student and peer staff,

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

For more than 40 years, Hamilton Families has been a leader in the movement to end family homelessness in San Francisco. We believe that every family deserves a safe place to call home and every child deserves the opportunity to thrive. Through our comprehensive programs—including emergency shelter, transitional housing, homelessness prevention, and rapid re-housing—we help families navigate housing crises and achieve long-term housing stability. But we know that housing alone is not enough. Guided by our ambitious Strategic Plan, Hamilton Families is expanding our approach to address the root causes of family homelessness: poverty and systemic inequality. By connecting families to opportunity-rich neighborhoods, centering children's needs, and providing comprehensive support that promotes long-term economic mobility, we're working to ensure that families don't just find housing—they have the resources and opportunities to thrive for generations.

**What You’ll Do**

The Development Team at Hamilton Families is responsible for securing $7–15 million annually and building meaningful partnerships with prominent national and Bay Area philanthropists, corporations, foundations, and community partners to advance our mission. jobs.title: Client Success & Events Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nowadays**
------------------

We're building the future of in-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to conference-level company events.

Nowadays is the AI-native platform for corporate event planning. We combine a 400K+ venue database, automated RFPs, and AI-driven venue outreach with a team that runs events end to end for some of the fastest-growing companies in tech. We're YC-backed, IATA-certified, and book millions in events every year. We move fast and care a lot about the client experience.

**Who we are**
--------------

We're a sister-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).

**We believe the best teams:**

* Take ownership
* Keep things scrappy
* Celebrate wins (big and small)
* Genuinely enjoy working (+ hanging out) together

**What this role is**
---------------------

As our Client Success & Events Manager, you'll own events end to end for high-profile tech clients, from kickoff to final budget reconciliation, and turn what you learn into automation. You'll sit at the intersection of clients, ops, and our product/engineering team.

Roughly 70% running events and client relationships, 30% building for scale: spotting manual steps in our workflow and partnering with engineering to automate them. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves the craft of a great event and gets equally excited about never doing the same task twice.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**70% of your time will focus on planning and running events**

* Deliver white-glove, end-to-end planning for high-profile tech clients: offsites, retreats, conferences, and dinners for 20 to 2,400+ attendees
* Own pre-planning once the venue is booked: turn the client's vision into a detailed plan and drive it to a flawless event day
* Source and manage vendors across activities, transportation, F&B, AV, branding and signage, gifting, and DMCs, using the Nowadays platform to move fast
* Own the planning deliverables and hit every deadline: workback schedule, weekly client sync + recap, rooming list, transport manifest, run of show, comms calendar, vendor payments (as payer of record), and budget reconciliation
* Be the trusted point of contact for client stakeholders, from executive assistants to people teams to founders
* Lead site visits and travel onsite to make sure events go off without a hitch
* Triage what's urgent vs. what can wait, and keep clients informed without being asked
* Proactively see what needs to happen next and execute it, with no nudging from the client required

**The remaining 30% of your time will focus on turning manual work into automation**

* Map how events actually get done today and find the steps that slow us down
* Write clear requirements and tickets for product/engineering, then test what ships
* Build playbooks, templates, and SOPs that the team can run without you
* Use AI tools to automate repetitive work yourself: vendor follow-ups, client updates, deadline reminders
* Bring client feedback into the product roadmap

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years of corporate event planning experience, ideally at a tech company, startup, agency, or DMC
* You've owned events end to end, including vendor management, budgets, and onsite execution
* Client-obsessed: you're calm under pressure and willing to flex for nights and weekends when an event needs it
* Highly organized with sharp attention to detail: you catch the wrong date in a contract before anyone else
* Clear, warm written communication with clients, vendors, and teammates
* Fast, reliable responsiveness: you reply to clients within hours, not days, and keep threads moving
* Hands-on experience using AI and automation tools (Claude, Zapier, Airtable, or similar) to replace manual work with repeatable processes
* A systems thinker who notices when something is done manually three times and wants to fix it
* Comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-moving startup environment

**Strongly preferred**
----------------------

* Events/Hospitality background

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Writing tickets in Linear or Jira, or working closely with engineers

**How you'll operate**
----------------------

A few of our values that matter most in this role:

* **Unreasonable Hospitality:** Getting the details right is service; how you make people feel is hospitality. You go further than anyone expects to delight our customers, from the first call to the last guest's ride home.
* **Customer's Best Friend:** You listen first and dig into what the client actually needs before reaching for a solution.
* **Extreme Ownership:** You own your events and your clients. You don't wait to be told what to do, and when something goes wrong, you fix it.
* **Growth Mindset:** You try new AI tools before anyone asks, and you're always looking for a better way to do the work.

**The details**
---------------

**Compensation**

$90K–$130K base + 0.2%–0.5% equity (depending on experience)

**Location**

In-person in San Francisco

**Perks**

* Free lunch + dinner in the office
* Quarterly team offsites and access to amazing venues
* Monthly fitness stipend
* Health insurance
* 12 weeks paid parental leave
* 20 days PTO
* Direct access to the founders and real ownership from day one

**How to apply**

Apply through the form on our careers page. Tell us about an event you're proud of, and one process you'd automate if you could.

**Qualifications**

Use your expertise to make a difference in disease research and drug discovery. AnaSpec’s custom and catalog products support scientists at biopharmaceutical companies, biotechnology organizations, and academic institutions worldwide.

For more information on our company, go to **www.anaspec.com**

**Mission**

The Territory Account Manager will grow AnaSpec’s U.S. business by strengthening existing customer relationships, developing new accounts, and achieving sales targets for our peptide and proteomics products and services.

This position will share U.S. territory coverage with another Territory Account Manager, with account assignments and sales responsibilities coordinated by the Deputy President. The successful candidate will bring hands-on scientific research experience, strong technical background and excellent oral and written communication skills to help customers identify solutions for their research needs.

Prior sales experience is not required. AnaSpec will provide sales training to support the transition from a research or life sciences role into technical account management.

This position reports to the Deputy President and works closely with Sales, Business Development, Marketing, and Production at our Fremont headquarters.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sales plans to retain existing customers, generate new business, and achieve assigned revenue targets.
* Develop and execute account growth plans through proactive customer contact, upselling, cross-selling, and reactivation of former customers.
* Develop a thorough understanding of AnaSpec’s products and services, including peptides, dyes, and proteomics reagents, to recommend solutions that meet customer needs.
* Build customer relationships through telephone calls, virtual meetings, in-person visits, and technical presentations.
* Prepare and coordinate quotations, follow up on proposals, and work with internal teams to convert opportunities into orders.
* Collaborate with Business Development on opportunities requiring specialized support or strategic account development.
* Maintain accurate customer records, sales activities, opportunities, and forecasts in the company’s CRM system.
* Monitor customer purchasing trends, competitor activity, and market developments to identify growth opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to address customer questions, project requirements, and service concerns.
* Participate in relevant trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings as needed.
* Follow applicable company policies, standard operating procedures, and Quality Management System requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
* At least 2-3 years of hands-on research or laboratory experience in life sciences, or in a university and/or academic research environment preferred. Relevant experience as a researcher, research associate, laboratory scientist, or in a comparable life sciences role is welcome.
* Strong technical knowledge of life sciences research, laboratory workflows, and experimental methods, with the ability to understand customer applications and scientific requirements.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain scientific concepts clearly, deliver technical presentations, and prepare accurate, professional correspondence.
* Ability to listen carefully, ask technical questions, and build relationships with researchers and other scientific customers.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office
* Must be based locally in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to commute regularly to AnaSpec’s Fremont headquarters.
* Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 25 pounds.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with peptides, proteomics, or related research products and applications.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, SAP, or SAP C4C; experience working with international teams is a plus.

**Location and Travel**

* Candidates living within approximately a 30–45-minute drive of Fremont, California, are preferred.
* Regular attendance at AnaSpec’s Fremont headquarters is required for training, team meetings, customer-related activities, and other business needs.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% of the time for customer visits, conferences, and other business activities.

Annual base salary of $75K-$80K plus a commission package and benefits.
