jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
**About Browserbase**
---------------------

Browserbase is the complete platform for building and deploying AI agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. With a single API key, developers can enable agents to search and retrieve information, fill out forms, and take action across websites. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion.

We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web.

**About the role**
------------------

As an Enterprise Technical Customer Success Manager, you’ll own long-term partnerships with customers whose implementations span multiple teams, stakeholders, and business priorities. You’ll help engineering teams build reliable production workflows while ensuring executive sponsors understand the value Browserbase delivers.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can move confidently between debugging an integration, coordinating a complex rollout, and leading an executive conversation about business outcomes. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous situations and maintain accountability from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the post-sale lifecycle for a focused portfolio of enterprise customers, creating joint success plans with measurable outcomes, milestones, owners, and dependencies.
* Lead complex onboarding and adoption programs across engineering, product, and business teams; coordinate security, procurement, and other internal stakeholders when they affect customer progress.
* Read customer code, understand system architecture, and troubleshoot integrations. Guide discussions about reliability, scale, and production readiness in partnership with Engineering.
* Build relationships across technical champions, executive sponsors, and commercial decision-makers so success does not depend on a single contact.
* Run weekly customer meetings with clear agendas, written follow-ups, accountable owners, and reliable closure of commitments. Lead technical workshops, onboarding plans, and escalation reviews as needed.
* Lead QBRs and executive business reviews with senior leaders, connecting adoption and workflow performance to business value and decisions about future investment.
* Own renewal strategy and execution: establish the value case early, manage objections and decision processes, maintain a clear forecast, and close renewals with or without Sales involvement.
* Partner with Sales to develop expansion opportunities across additional teams and use cases, grounded in demonstrated customer needs and outcomes.
* Combine usage, technical performance, stakeholder engagement, and business context to identify risks; lead recovery plans and coordinate escalations through resolution.
* Manage substantial feature-request pipelines: clarify use cases and business impact, advocate for priorities with Product and Engineering, communicate tradeoffs and status, and close the loop without promising uncommitted roadmap work.
* Develop playbooks that strengthen enterprise delivery across the CS team.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* 5+ years in Technical Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, or Technical Account Management, with substantial experience owning enterprise customer relationships. We expect many strong candidates to bring 5–8+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience in a revenue-generating role, with direct accountability for strategic accounts, renewals, and expansion. You can point to commercial outcomes you personally owned.
* Hands-on ability to read and troubleshoot JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, work with APIs and SDKs, interpret logs, and discuss infrastructure and application architecture with engineers.
* Experience coordinating technical implementations across teams, resolving competing priorities, and keeping work moving through dependencies and escalations.
* A track record of stakeholder mapping and multi-threading at large companies, building executive alignment, presenting business value, and guiding difficult commercial or delivery conversations.
* Experience with engineering-heavy customers, earning trust through technical specificity, preparation, and consistent follow-through.
* Strong judgment about when to solve an issue directly and when to bring in Engineering, Product, or commercial partners.
* Clear communication, customer empathy, and the independence to build structure in a fast-moving startup.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with enterprise developer tools, cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, AI infrastructure, data infrastructure, or security products.
* Experience with browser automation and tools such as Stagehand, Playwright, or Selenium.
* Familiarity with enterprise security reviews, procurement processes, and production reliability requirements.
* Experience mentoring teammates or building enterprise success methodologies.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Customers launch and sustain reliable production workflows, demonstrate measurable business value, and build durable relationships with Browserbase across their organizations. Renewals are well prepared, risks surface early, and expansion follows successful adoption.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary + meaningful early-stage equity
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* 401(k)
* Daily catered lunches with a fully-stocked kitchen
* Beautiful office in downtown San Francisco
* All the AI tools + credits you want
* Regular team offsites and company events

OTE (includes base + commission)

$211,500 - $264,5

Reporting to the Director of Social, you’ll lead our Social Leads, oversee content production across client accounts, and connect creative execution with measurable results. * **Spot the patterns.** Translate creative performance data into actionable insights and optimizations that improve results.

* **Build smarter systems.** Develop repeatable workflows, maintain AI knowledge bases, and document insights using structured markdown files.

**Key Qualifications:**

* **Systems & AI know-how.** Familiarity with AI tools, LLM workflows, structured markdown documentation, and project management platforms such as Asana.

* **Education.** Bachelor’s degree.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

**You’re the person who balances big picture social strategy with an instinct for what’s next, turning everyday opportunities into meaningful audience connections.**

* **You’re a natural leader.** You inspire, coach, and empower teams while holding everyone accountable.

* **You’re a master multitasker.** People, production schedules, budgets, deadlines, and data? You keep it all moving.

* **You’re a systems thinker.** You build smart, repeatable processes that make teams more efficient.

* **You’re data-driven.** You connect creative performance to actionable insights and measurable results.

* **You’re proactive and detail-obsessed.** You anticipate challenges, move with urgency, and never lose sight of the details.

**About H/L Agency**

Our business is energy—the in-motion kind. The creative kind. We make Momentum- for each other, for our clients, and for our community. That requires focus and an environment where doing the best work of your career is the expectation rather than the exception. That doesn’t happen in a place. **Great social doesn't just happen. Behind every post, conversation, and creator collaboration is someone making sure it all comes together.**

H/L Agency is looking for an organized, detail-oriented Social Media Specialist to support our Social Media & Influencer team in bringing our clients' social strategies to life.

In this hands-on execution and coordination role, you'll manage content calendars, publish organic social content, engage with online communities, and coordinate influencer and creator programs. You'll keep everything organized, on-brand, and on schedule while working closely with social leads, content creators, paid media, account teams, and our in-house production studio, Wolfhouse.

If you're social-savvy, collaborative, and love keeping the moving pieces moving, this could be your sweet spot.

* **Bring briefs to life.** Execute social strategies and creative briefs accurately, ensuring content, captions, and channel presentation stay on-brand and approved.
* **Keep the conversation going.** Monitor and respond to community interactions in each brand's voice, escalating issues and sharing audience insights.

**Influencer & Creator Programs**

* **Find the right voices.** Source and vet influencers and creators, supporting brand-safe partnerships through CreatorIQ.
* **Make collaborations happen.** Coordinate creator briefs, contracts, usage rights, product shipments, communications, and approvals.
* **Keep creators on track.** Monitor deliverables, content performance, and payments, flagging opportunities for paid amplification.

**Trends, Performance & Collaboration**

* **Stay ahead of the scroll.** Monitor social trends, emerging creators, and cultural moments, sharing relevant opportunities with the team.
* **Make the data talk.** Track social and influencer performance, prepare reports, and highlight actionable insights.
* **Keep things moving.** Coordinate with social leads, content creators, paid media, account teams, and Wolfhouse to manage assets, approvals, and deadlines.

**Key Qualifications:**

* **Social media experience.** 1–3 years in social media, influencer marketing, or community management. Agency experience is a plus.
* **Platform fluency.** Working knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Pinterest, including formats, trends, and best practices.
* **Influencer know-how.** Experience sourcing and coordinating creators, with familiarity with briefs, contracts, usage rights, and disclosure requirements. CreatorIQ experience is preferred.
* **Content & community coordination.** Experience scheduling content, managing approvals, engaging audiences, and maintaining brand consistency.
* **Analytics & reporting.** Comfortable using social analytics tools and translating performance data into clear reports.
* **Communication & organization.** Strong writing skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* **Technical proficiency.** Familiarity with social scheduling tools and basic editing using Canva, CapCut, or similar platforms.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

**You're the behind-the-scenes MVP who keeps the details dialed in and the work moving forward.**

* **You're organized.** Calendars, content, creators, and deadlines? You've got them covered.
* **You're social-savvy.** You understand the platforms, follow trends, and know how brands connect with audiences.
* **You're proactive.** You anticipate needs, flag issues early, and follow through.
* **You're a natural collaborator.** You communicate easily with creators, teammates, and clients.
* **You're a brand chameleon.** You adapt your voice and approach across brands, audiences, and platforms.
* **You're detail-obsessed.** From captions and approvals to creator deliverables, you catch the little things that make a big difference.

Share your resume and examples of social media accounts, community management, or influencer campaigns you've supported.

jobs.title: Enterprise Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Airbyte:**
------------------

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.

We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.

Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.

We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.

**The Role:**
-------------

As an Enterprise Business Development Representative (BDR) at Airbyte, you will play a critical role in driving our expansion into the enterprise market. This strategic position focuses on identifying key decision-makers and generating high-quality sales meetings within enterprise accounts.

You will have a direct impact on enterprise revenue while developing the skills, experience, and relationships that will accelerate your career in sales.

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

* Hunt and prospect into enterprise accounts and generate meetings with stakeholders across all levels, from C-suite executives to data engineers.
* Create personalized, compelling outbound outreach at scale to build relationships and drive qualified sales meetings.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives and GTM Engineers to generate pipeline and exceed revenue goals.
* Develop a deep understanding of the enterprise data and AI landscape, customer challenges, and how Airbyte helps organizations unlock the full value of their data.
* Gather and share customer insights with Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to continuously improve our go-to-market approach.

**What You’ll Need:**
---------------------

* 1+ years of customer-facing sales experience, ideally in a B2B technology environment. Previous SDR/BDR experience is a plus but not required.
* A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments and operate with autonomy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex concepts.
* Familiarity with modern GTM tools such as Nooks, Common Room, Claude and Salesforce or a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly and leverage AI as part of your daily workflow.
* A consistent, disciplined approach to high-volume prospecting, while maintaining relevance and quality across cold calls, emails, and follow-ups.

**Location:**
-------------

* Onsite 4 days/week in San Francisco, CA

**Why You'll Love Working at Airbyte:**
---------------------------------------

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:

* Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually
* 16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement
* Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement
* Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office
* A collaborative, in-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact

If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements!

We are not accepting agency submissions or recruiting firm support for this role. Unsolicited resumes will not be considered.

Airbyte is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, familial status, domestic violence victim status, veteran or military status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Airbyte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodations due to a disability.

Compensation Range: $0 - $107K

**Location:** San Francisco, CA

* Actively prospect and acquire new customers within the designated territory through effective networking and lead development.
* Identify growth opportunities and prospects for new customer acquisition.
* Enhance customer loyalty and drive account growth by developing relationships with customers.

* Consult with customers to understand their business needs and offer creative solutions to solve workforce needs Effectively sell the PeopleReady service offerings.

* Proactively solution cross sell opportunities across all TrueBlue brands and neighboring markets.
* Develop account management and sales strategies to increase share of wallet and customer retention.
* Lead formal business reviews with key customers to assess performance and identify growth opportunities.
* Utilize appropriate technology and tools to develop and maintain comprehensive account management and growth strategies.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments to effectively position TrueBlue products/services.
* Mentor other sales reps and client facing employees.

**Education and Experience**

* Three or more years related sales experience; Bachelors, associate degree; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Managed a portfolio of at least $2.5M per annum.
* Sales experience in one or more blue-collar market verticals.
* Proven track record of exceeding sales targets.
* Experience in understanding, adapting, and applying new technologies.
* Valid driver license, registered vehicle, and vehicle insurance.

**Core Knowledge and Skills**

* Communicates clearly, concisely, and professionally in both written and verbal forms
* Adept at persuading diverse customer stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
* Capable of prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines effectively under pressure
* Analytical abilities: skilled in analyzing order, associate, and customer data to drive informed decisions and achieve outcomes
* Competitive drive

***In-Home Sales Representative***
==================================

### ***Transforming Bathrooms. Changing Lives. Building Careers.***

We help homeowners transform their bathrooms with stylish, affordable, and low-maintenance solutions designed to fit their lifestyle and budget. Our reputation is built on quality craftsmanship, exceptional customer service, and delivering results that exceed expectations.

We're looking for ambitious, driven sales professionals who want to take control of their income and build a rewarding career with unlimited earning potential.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As an In-Home Sales Representative, you'll meet with pre-qualified homeowners who have requested information about our remodeling services. Using industry-leading sales tools and technology, you'll design customized solutions, present pricing options, and help customers bring their vision to life.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Conduct professional in-home sales presentations with pre-qualified leads
* Design customized bath remodeling solutions using proprietary technology
* Present product options, pricing, and financing solutions
* Build rapport and establish trust with homeowners
* Close sales and deliver a best-in-class customer experience
* Attend ongoing training and development sessions to enhance sales performance
* Maintain accurate customer and sales records

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Strong communication and relationship-building skills
* Motivated, competitive, and goal-oriented mindset
* Ability to confidently present and close sales
* Excellent organization and time-management skills
* In-home sales experience preferred
* Home improvement or remodeling sales experience is a plus
* Professional appearance and positive attitude
* Reliable transportation

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **100% Commission-Based Position**
* **Unlimited Earning Potential**
* **Expected Earnings: $150,000 - $200,000+ per year**
* Pre-qualified leads provided
* Comprehensive sales training and ongoing coaching
* Industry-leading products with strong consumer demand
* Flexible schedule with high income potential
* Growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding organization

jobs.description:
**About the Agency:**

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.

As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

**Your Team**

The FOIL Administrative Coordinator will be a member of the Public Information team within the agency’s Office of Compliance & Risk Management (CRM). This office includes various compliance, oversight, and hearing functions to ensure fairness, consistency, and equity in both our external and internal engagement. CRM collaborates with programs across HPD to ensure the agency and its partners comply with laws (federal, state, and city), regulatory requirements, policies, and procedures. The Office includes the following Divisions and units:

· Compliance & Strategy

· Economic Opportunity & Regulatory Compliance

· Audit Support

· Adjudications

· Public Information

HPD’s Public Information team is dedicated to serving the public by collaborating with internal partners and governing entities to facilitate access to agency information. The team promotes accountability, transparency, and compliance by:

· Establishing robust infrastructure within the agency to improve record retention and quality;

· Ensuring fair and secure access to agency records and materials for members of the public; and

· Safeguarding sensitive information by setting and maintaining best practices around data privacy and effective record management.

**Your Impact**

As a member of the Public Information team in CRM, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will support transparency and public access to information relating to HPD’s mission to provide secure and safe housing in New York City.

**Your Role**

Reporting under general supervision of the Deputy Records Access Officer and FOIL and the eDiscovery Specialist on a dedicated project basis, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will support the agency’s Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) program, working with the FOIL team on a segment of its redaction portfolio. Working in coordination with offices throughout the agency, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will gain an understanding of the different types of work done by the agency, develop relationships with people throughout HPD, and apply their customer service skills.

The records involved in this project will include, but not be limited to, Complaint Records, Violation Records, and Regulatory Agreements. All activity will be conducted under FOIL supervision.

**Your Responsibilities**

The FOIL Administrative Coordinator will be trained and instructed on requirements and software involved in the following duties:

· Search and retrieve responsive documents from specific agency and/or City websites

· Redact responsive records documents using Adobe Pro software

· Submit redacted documents to the FOIL team for review

· Enter completed FOILs information in an excel spreadsheet

· Assist with obtaining documents from program areas

· Review documents provided by agency personnel to ensure that the FOIL responses are accurate and complete

· Assist with quality assurance checks of FOILs

· Support FOIL requests and inquiries from the public as needed

· Other tasks and requirements identified as the staff becomes more familiar with the agency documents and information

**Please submit a cover letter as part of your application.**

**Preferred Skills**

The ideal candidate will be an inquisitive self-starter and problem-solver with administrative experience.

· Exercises discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information

· Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities

· Effective verbal and written communication skills

· Ability to multi-task with high volume workload

· Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written)

· The ability to keep track of time-sensitive projects, and coordinate with various parties to help complete them

· Comfortable with reading and interpreting documents

**How to Apply:**

Please send resume and cover letter to the HPD FOIL team via AskCompliance@hpd.nyc.gov and include the position in the subject line.

**Salary range:** $32.50/hour for 35 hours/week

**NOTE:** Only those candidates under consideration will be contacted.

Pay: $32.50 per hour

Work Location: In person

**Clinical Research Coordinator I** will oversee multiple clinical trials, investigator-initiated studies, and quality improvement projects within the Department of Neurology and support the Department's programs, serving as a point person for patients, their family members and the clinical study team. The position consists of working with various departments across the hospital, including forging new partnerships with departments to ensure completion of trial-related activities. The Clinical Research Coordinator I will direct participants and study team members to adhere to the study protocol and rules and regulations as governed by regulatory bodies including Institutional Review Boards and the FDA.

  

Under general supervision duties will include:

• Directing seamless flow of daily trial-related activities, recruitment and clinical assessments of the study subjects

• Directing strict adherence to the study protocols, as well as sponsor, FDA and other regulatory authority requirements.

• Designs and implements workflows for clinical trials, including reminders/updates to the clinical team

• Coordinating team members to complete both clinical and non-clinical assessments per protocol. This includes developing workflow for patient care such as assigning secretaries to schedule patients, developing workflow with ancillary departments (such as radiology, advanced imaging, pathology, pharmacy), and assigning appropriate clinical team members such as doctors to complete clinical tasks such as reviewing adverse events versus assigning non-clinical team members to complete non-clinical tasks such as administering questionnaires to a patient.

• Executing IRB submissions (event reporting, study status change etc.)

• Executing patient billing in multiple databases including the patient's electronic medical record.

• Developing action plans for ensuring all study tasks are completed as required per the protocol and developing subsequent corrective action plans if any errors are made.

• Coordinating appointments, procedures, and related services, and supporting financial activities.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I will be trained to be highly specialized in clinical trials assigned to them. The Clinical Research Coordinator I is expected to be able to manage clinical trial projects independently after sufficient training is completed.

  

**Essential Functions**

• Escalates issues related to clinical trial conduct to PI and senior research staff.

• Assigns training to the PI and other research team members for protocol amendments, and any other study required training.

• Screens and consents patients and ensures the scheduling and completion of assessments for ongoing study visits as dictated by the protocol.

• Schedules and coordinates appointments, procedures, and related services; records documentation, communications, and related information in the electronic medical record and other systems.

• Serves as a point of contact for patients, providers, sponsors, vendors, and other internal and external parties.

• Collects required data and imaging and ensures data entry into EDCs/Databases and image upload to imaging portals.

• Develops and executes multifaceted recruitment strategies by blending creative patient outreach with technical workflow integration and cross-departmental partnerships to optimize subject identification and enrollment.

• Oversees the quality of data provided to sponsor, escalates quality issues to the site manager.

• Maintains accurate records of study participants while safeguarding the confidentiality of subjects, as necessary.

• Maintains essential documents per FDA, Regulatory bodies, and sponsor requirements in the Regulatory Binder. This includes preparation of essential documents for the assigned clinical study.

• Provides ready access to patient binders and regulatory binders to the PI, Sponsor and/or Regulatory Authorities for assigned clinical trials.

• Coordinates and carries out monitoring visits and audits for assigned clinical trials.

• Collaborates with appropriate institutional review board to ensure approval of the clinical trial (renewal), approval of study documents (renewal, modification, notification) and personnel.

• Assists management with collection of updated essential documents and certifications for site personnel and sends these to sponsor as requested.

• Participates in Site Initiation Visit.

• Processes, packages, stores and ships clinical specimens as required by the protocol.

• Responsible for device accountability, ordering and storage of investigational products and/or lab kits.

• Prepares correspondence, reports, meeting materials, and minutes; maintains, organizes, and archives records in accordance with institutional, sponsor, and regulatory requirements; and maintains inventory of supplies and equipment and coordinates with vendors.

• Provides administrative and operational support to the Department as needed and performs other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**

• BS Required

• OHS Annual Assessment Required

• OHS Fit Test Required

• CITI Good Clinical Practice Certification, CITI Research with Biomedical Drugs and Devices Certification, CITI Dan gerous Goods and Biospecimen Handling Certification.

• Experience in clinical research, clinical trials and/or any medical related profession Preferred

This position will be based at a Department of Neurology campus, with occasional travel to other Montefiore locations as needed.

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Teleskope**

Teleskope is the only data security platform that automatically resolves data exposure. Powered by its Data Reasoning Layer that understands business context, Teleskope continuously discovers and classifies risky data, determines the appropriate action, and enforces it natively across on-prem, cloud, SaaS, and AI environments, without manual triage or external tools. Unlike DSPM tools that surface findings and stop there, Teleskope closes the loop between detection and resolution. Customers include Ramp, Petco, Dayforce and Notion.

In this agentic era, data risk has quickly become the most widespread, exploitable and urgent challenge faced by enterprises. Teleskope’s unique ability to resolve data risk as it arises positions us as a critical partner to the world’s largest enterprises, helping them to protect their most valuable assets while safely adopting AI.

The market is catching on, and Teleskope is growing like crazy. This is an opportunity to own a critical territory, selling a one-of-a-kind product that sits at the intersection of Data Security and AI Security.

**About the role**

We are seeking an **Enterprise Technical Account Manager** who will be the strategic partner and primary post-sales owner for our largest customers. In this role, you will help customers operationalize Teleskope, drive adoption across teams and stakeholders, and support their most urgent and critical data security initiatives.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Product, and Engineering teams to guide customers from conversion through onboarding, implementation, steady-state success, and renewal/upsell. This role is ideal for someone who is highly customer-facing, consultative, and comfortable navigating technical conversations alongside our FDE’s.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the customer relationship after deal close, serving as the primary driver of customer outcomes, adoption, and long-term account health
* Develop and track success plans with defined milestones, business goals, use cases, stakeholders, and measurable success criteria, ensuring customers have a seamless experience operationalizing Teleskope
* Run recurring calls with customers to track progress, remove blockers, align on priorities, and maintain momentum toward shared goals
* Track account health using customer feedback, milestone attainment, product gaps, platform usage, and ensure we are well positioned to retain customers
* Plan, coordinate and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR’s), ensuring customer stakeholders understand the value delivered by Teleskope
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback, prioritize key gaps, and advocate for high-value improvements
* Support growth within existing accounts by identifying expansion opportunities, new use cases, and deeper platform adoption paths
* Partner with GTM leadership on renewal planning and customer communications, including stakeholder mapping, renewal readiness, and executive alignment
* Maintain clear customer-facing and internal documentation, including account plans, meeting notes, milestone trackers, success criteria, and escalation summaries
* Help shape and scale Teleskope’s customer success motion, processes, playbooks, and reporting as the company grows

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years in Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer-facing role working closely with technical stakeholders
* Experience owning customer relationships with large enterprises
* Strong fundamentals of account management – building rapport, managing relationships, driving account health, and owning customer success
* Comfort working with technical stakeholders and discussing deployments, integrations, cloud environments, and troubleshooting workflows at a high level
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business value for security, data, engineering, and executive audiences
* Extreme organization, with strong program management instincts and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills, including experience running recurring syncs, workshops, and executive reviews.
* Familiarity with modern SaaS tooling such as CRM systems, project trackers, documentation tools, and customer success workflows.
* **Experience in data security, cloud security, privacy, governance, or adjacent technical domains is a requirement.**
* Must be based in NYC (we work hybrid, in-office Tue/Wed/Thu).

**What You'll Get**

* An opportunity to help shape the core customer experience at an early-stage startup in one of today’s fastest-growing markets.
* Huge opportunity to impact Teleskope's growth and success in the market, working directly with large enterprise customers and Teleskope executives.
* Room to learn, grow, and rapidly advance in your career as part of a growing team.
* A beautiful office in NYC’s Financial District, with breakfast and snacks provided daily, and weekly catered lunch.
* Flexible vacation and work-from-home days.
* Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
* Health, vision, dental, 401k and more benefits, heavily subsidized by Teleskope.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

**Description**

Vector Solutions is a leading software company delivering an AI-enabled, performance platform powering safe, compliant, and efficient operations for the public, educational, and commercial sectors. We bring training, safety, and workforce operations together to boost readiness, reduce risk, and drive high-performance results for the everyday heroes who count on us.

Skills Intelligence is a new AI-native software product Vector brought to market in Q4-2026 for industrial manufacturing companies, and this role owns the post-sales experience for it. You'll own the full customer journey, from implementation through adoption and, ultimately, renewal. That starts with getting brand-new and existing Vector customers live and seeing value fast, then building the relationships with each customer and results that keep them renewing and growing with us.

This is an exciting opportunity to help launch and shape a brand-new product line and service inside an established, well-resourced company. You'll get to help craft the customer playbook from the ground up, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and leadership and working in a best-in-class, AI-native product.

As the Technical Account Manager for Skills Intelligence, you'll own every customer's journey, from the moment a deal closes through go-live, adoption, expansion, and renewal. You'll lead implementations, turn new users into engaged ones, and own the renewal for every account in your book, building the trust and results that keep customers growing with Vector year after year. Because Skills Intelligence is brand new, you'll also help build the playbook every future Skills Intelligence customer runs on.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own each implementation from sales handoff through go-live, including kickoff, configuration, data setup, and training. Note this system was built with an AI-ingestion tool that will do most of the heavy technical lifting, but you will make sure this output meets the customer’s vision

**Drive Adoption and Value**

* Act as the primary point of contact after go-live, handling support questions and escalations.
* Track usage and adoption, and step in with targeted training or enablement when engagement drops.
* Lead regular business reviews that tie Skills usage back to each customer's goals and measurable outcomes.
* Monitor account health, flag risks early, and step in with a plan before small issues become renewal risks.

**Own Renewals and Growth**

* Own the renewal for every account in your book, from forecasting and risk mitigation through negotiation and signature.
* Get ahead of retention with weekly, high-touch check-ins. With renewals still a year out, this is your chance to build real relationships and set customers up to renew with confidence next year.
* Spot expansion opportunities and partner with Sales to grow accounts.
* Keep Salesforce current with account health, renewal forecasts, and expansion pipeline.

**Partner with the Team (Ronda, Joey, Kenny) to Build the Skills Playbook**

* Define the implementation of methodology, onboarding resources, and training materials for Skills Intelligence.
* Serve as an early voice of the customer, sharing product feedback and market signal to help shape the roadmap.
* Document best practices and repeatable processes as you go so the Skills team can scale.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* 3-5 years in software implementation, technical account management, onboarding, or customer success, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Familiarity with industrial manufacturing space is preferred.
* Proven track record of leading implementations with multiple stakeholders from kickoff to go-live.
* Experience owning renewals and retention for a book of business.
* Strong technical aptitude: comfortable with software configuration, data setup, and troubleshooting, and quick to learn new platforms.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple customers at once.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to senior leaders.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build processes for a new product.
* Proficient in Salesforce and Microsoft Office, with genuine interest in AI tools.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.

**What You Can Expect From Us:**

* Friendly, open, and casual work environment
* Comprehensive benefits package effective the first of the month after hire
* Matching 401(k) retirement plan
* Healthy work-life balance with flexible work arrangements and generous time off
* Generous referral incentive program
* Tuition Reimbursement Program
* Pet Insurance

* Calm Health-Employee Membership
* Company social events
* Employee Resource Groups
* Philanthropic opportunities

**What We Value:**

* **Teamwork** - Above all, we’re a team. We give and value feedback. We support each other, respect each other and work together to accomplish our common goals and serve our customers. Once we make decisions, we align behind them as a team.
* **Customers First** - Our customers’ success is our success. They are why we are here. We work to earn the trust of our customers and always deliver on our commitments.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Passage Health**
========================

Passage Health is a fast-growing Series A startup on a mission to improve the quality and accessibility of autism care through technology. Autism diagnosis rates have surged over the past decade to 1 in 31 children, yet families still face waitlists of up to a year for care as providers—hampered by antiquated technology and manual workflows—struggle to meet surging demand.

We’re building the platform that modernizes how autism care providers work—from clinical documentation to operations to billing—transforming how care is delivered and scaling access across a $460B market.

Over the past year, Passage has grown more than 3x, driven by strong customer demand and expanding partnerships across the autism care ecosystem. As we scale, we’re focused on building durable foundations—the systems, processes, and decision-making needed to support long-term growth.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
========================

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our customer team. This is an exciting opportunity to help refine and evolve our customer function, where you'll navigate ambiguity with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, untangle tricky customer problems, and directly contribute to our customers' success.. You’ll bring curiosity and drive as you collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementations, form trusted partnerships, and help guide product improvements through customer feedback.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **Customer Onboarding:** Own the end-to-end customer onboarding process for a portfolio of customers, ensuring timely and seamless transitions, and proactively guiding customers through challenges.
* **Customer Success:** Build and maintain strong relationships with a wide range of customer stakeholders, acting as their trusted advisor and point of contact. Monitor engagement, drive adoption, and surface issues early so customers stay and grow with us.
* **Customer Support:** Partner with our Support team to develop clear documentation and hands-on guidance that helps top-tier customers navigate complex workflows with confidence.
* **Product Feedback & Improvements:** Gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape product enhancements, acting as the customer’s voice within our team.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Sales, Product, and Support teams to deliver a smooth, high-quality customer experience.

**What You’ll Bring**
=====================

* **Experience:** 3–5 years in Customer Success, Onboarding, Implementation, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally in SaaS or healthcare technology.
* **Customer-Centric Mindset:** Strong passion for helping customers succeed, backed by a track record of building lasting relationships and delivering real outcomes.
* **Complex Problem-Solving:** A talent for breaking down thorny, multi-stakeholder customer challenges, thinking critically, and seeing them through to resolution.
* **Drive & Comfort with Ambiguity:** An ownership mindset that thrives amid the ambiguity of a young company still finding its shape—taking initiative, moving quickly, and following through with care.
* **Curiosity & Continuous Learning:** Genuinely curious about customers, the product, and the autism care space, with a habit of asking questions and always seeking better ways to work.
* **Collaboration:** A team player who builds rapport easily and brings others along to get things done.
* **Project Management:** Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects and competing priorities without dropping details.
* **Excellent Communication:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and effectively.

**Why Passage Health?**
=======================

* Outsized impact—as an early employee, your work will shape both the company and our users’ experience.
* Meaningful work using your skills to help children with autism.
* A fast-paced environment full of substantive challenges.
* Competitive salary and equity.
* Healthcare, dental, and vision benefits.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
===============================

*Passage Health is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all applicants from every background and life experience, without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

Compensation Range: $90K - $140K

jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

* **Contract type:** Permanent, Full-time
* **Reports to:** Head of Digital Partnerships & Distribution – London *(dotted line to Head of U.S. Marketing & Fan Activation)*
* **Location:** Premier League Offices, New York City, USA

**Overview**

The Premier League has established an in-market presence to accelerate fan and commercial growth across the U.S. With the U.S. being a key priority market for the Premier League, there is significant focus on driving acquisition and engagement of fans. To help with this growth, the league is seeking to recruit a Digital Marketing Manager to work across the Premier League’s digital marketing and fan development operations in the U.S.

This exciting new role will report into the Head of Digital Partnerships & Distribution, and collaborate with global digital, content, marketing, events and broadcast teams. This role will also work across the broader business to understand the Premier League’s opportunities to help drive U.S. progress.

This role will manage and support on opportunities to grow and broaden the Premier League’s U.S. audience across the League’s owned and operated ecosystem – resulting in stronger and deeper fan engagement not only for the Premier League, but also with our Clubs, broadcast and commercial partners.

The ideal candidate will have a mix of experiences in performance marketing, CRM growth, digital product marketing and paid media. The ideal candidate should have an affinity for sports, be well-versed in digital marketing and consider themselves a self-starter.  
  
**Who we are**  
The Premier League is home to some of the most competitive and compelling football in the world. The League and its Clubs use the power and popularity of the competition to inspire fans, communities and partners in the UK and across the world. The Premier League brings people together from all backgrounds. It is a competition for everyone, everywhere and is available to watch in over 1.2 billion homes in 189 countries.

We have a wide variety of responsibilities. These include organizing the competition and its Handbook as well as managing the centralized broadcast and commercial rights. The work we do in conjunction with the Clubs also goes far beyond the 90 minutes. We support and provide a framework for youth development, we protect the organisation’s intellectual property, support the wider game and community programmes, undertake international development work and liaise with governing bodies and other leagues.

Our hybrid-working model also allows you some variety on your place of work, offering you the chance to work from home on some days each week. Where possible, you will attend the office or site visits in line with our company policy. All staff liaise closely with their line manager to manage their time appropriately and according to their work and team requirements.

### **The role**

The U.S. Digital Marketing Manager will act as the day-to-day point of contact with the global Digital Partnerships and Distribution team. The role will be responsible for the following in collaboration with the U.S. team, and global digital, and audience development teams:

**Performance Marketing & Fan Acquisition**

* Collaborate with global Digital team to plan, execute, and optimize local paid marketing campaigns across digital channels.
* Manage acquisition budgets and media agencies to deliver growth against defined KPIs.
* Continuously test creative, audience segments, messaging, and landing pages to improve performance.
* Develop audience acquisition strategies focused on attracting new Premier League fans across the U.S.

**First-Party Data & CRM Growth**

* Coordinate execution of initiatives designed to increase fan registrations, first party data capture, and CRM database growth.
* Manage campaigns and journeys supporting fan identification and record acquisition.
* Partner with product, analytics, and CRM teams to improve conversion funnels and registration experiences.
* Ensure data collection programs comply with applicable privacy regulations and Premier League standards.

**Lifecycle Marketing**

* Support and execute end-to-end fan lifecycle programs across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other owned channels.
* Build audience segmentation strategies to increase engagement, retention, and reactivation.
* Deliver automated campaigns to drive repeat engagement with Premier League digital products and content.

**Fantasy Premier League & Digital Product Marketing**

* Develop and execute season-long marketing campaigns supporting Fantasy Premier League and App growth in the U.S.
* Drive awareness, acquisition, retention, and engagement for Fantasy Premier League and other digital fan products.
* Collaborate with product, content, creative, and social teams to deliver integrated campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to increase participation and engagement throughout the football season.
* Collaborate with product team to identify product enhancement opportunities.
* Day to day management of U.S. digital hub. Collaborate with Content and Marketing teams to develop season-long content and promotional plan.

**Analytics & Insights**

* Monitor campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations.
* Track and report on key metrics, including:

o Customer acquisition cost (CAC).

o Cost per registration (CPR).

o Conversion rates.

o Engagement and retention metrics.

o Lifetime value indicators.

* Leverage data and market insights to inform optimization strategies.
* Manage delivery of regular data and insights reporting to track KPI performance in collaboration with global digital & agencies.

jobs.title: Sales Representative, Architecture & Design
jobs.description:
About MICRO:

MICRO is a premium architectural finishes company specializing in microcement systems. We supply and install decorative finishes for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects across North America. We control everything from product supply to certified installation, so quality and accountability stay consistent on every project. We train our certified installers in-house, and are available on Material Bank.

The role:  
We're looking for a motivated, design-savvy Sales Representative who loves building real relationships with the architecture and design community. You'll grow and manage a portfolio of accounts in your territory, open new business, and work closely with our Sales Manager to expand MICRO's presence in the market.

This isn't a transactional sales job. Our process is consultative: you'll work with designers and architects over weeks or months to get MICRO specified on projects, then support the client through installation and completion.

What you'll do:  
- Find and develop new business in your assigned territory  
- Build strong relationships with architects, interior designers, general contractors, and developers  
- Present MICRO's products, capabilities, and installation process to clients and specifiers  
- Get MICRO specified in project documents at the design development stage  
- Manage an active pipeline from first contact to signed contract  
- Run site visits, client meetings, and showroom presentations  
- Deliver and follow up on sample requests promptly  
- Attend industry events, trade shows, and networking functions  
- Keep accurate, up-to-date records in HubSpot CRM  
- Work with the Sales Manager and operations team to make project delivery seamless  
- Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets

What we're looking for:  
- 2 to 5 years of sales experience, ideally in architecture, interior design, construction, or luxury materials  
- Existing relationships in the design and build community (a strong plus)  
- Specification or consultative selling experience (preferred)  
- Familiarity with construction, building materials, or decorative finishes  
- CRM experience, HubSpot preferred  
- Ability to read architectural drawings and design specifications  
- Confident presenting to senior designers, architects, and project stakeholders  
- Strong organization across many projects and follow-ups at once  
- Self-motivated and comfortable working independently  
- Patient with long sales cycles and relationship-based selling  
- A genuine passion for design, interiors, and premium finishes, and a polished, professional presence

What we offer:  
- Competitive base salary plus commission  
- Territory ownership: build your own book of business  
- Room to grow with a fast-scaling premium brand  
- Ongoing product training and professional development  
- Support from an experienced Sales Manager and operations team

jobs.description:
**Role overview**
-----------------

Newlab is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant to support our Global Head of Business and SVP of Operations.

This is an opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys keeping things organized, solving problems, and helping busy teams operate effectively. You'll play an important role in managing schedules, coordinating meetings and travel, tracking follow-ups, and making sure the day-to-day details are taken care of so our leaders can focus on their highest priorities.

You'll work closely with two senior leaders and collaborate with colleagues across Newlab's locations and functions, gaining exposure to a fast-moving business working at the intersection of technology, industry, and economic development.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and eager to learn. We're looking for someone who takes pride in being helpful, follows through on commitments, and brings a positive, solutions-oriented approach to their work.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Executive Support & Calendar Management**

* Manage day-to-day scheduling and calendars for Emilie and Dan, ensuring their time reflects their most important business priorities.
* Help prioritize incoming meeting requests, protect focus time, and ensure schedules are organized around key commitments.
* Look ahead to anticipate scheduling conflicts, upcoming meetings, travel needs, and other logistical considerations.
* Serve as a friendly and responsive point of contact for internal and external stakeholders coordinating with the executives.
* Develop a strong understanding of priorities, proactively identifying competing demands, escalating time-sensitive decisions, and ensuring appropriate attention is given to the highest-impact initiatives.

### **Meeting Coordination, Preparation & Follow-Through**

* Schedule regular team meetings, project reviews, and recurring check-ins across the commercialization and finance/operations groups.
* Coordinate pre-meeting preparation: follow up with meeting owners to ensure agendas, presentations, and background reading are ready and distributed well in advance.
* Identify when a team member needs a quick pre-alignment conversation with Emilie or Dan before a broader review, and get it on the calendar.
* Track meeting outcomes, capture clear next steps, and follow up with team members on their action items to keep projects moving.
* Maintain visibility into key executive commitments, decisions, and follow-ups across meetings, correspondence, and ongoing initiatives, proactively flagging items requiring attention or escalation.

### **Administrative support and logistics**

* Book travel arrangements and build clear, detailed travel itineraries.
* Organize logistics for internal team gatherings, reviews, and occasional offsites.
* Prepare and submit monthly expense reports.
* Serve as an approachable, organized point of contact for colleagues looking to connect with Emilie and Dan.
* Support executive correspondence, including triage, drafting routine communications, coordinating responses, and flagging time-sensitive matters requiring executive attention.

**Qualifications and qualities**
--------------------------------

* **Relevant experience:** Proven experience in an administrative support or executive assistant role, with a track record of supporting busy leaders.
* **Project management mindset:** Highly organized and process-oriented. Able to track multiple moving pieces, coordinate project reviews, and ensure tasks do not slip through the cracks.
* **Diplomatic assertiveness:** Comfortable managing up, nudging colleagues for overdue prep materials, and holding people accountable to deadlines with tact, warmth, and professionalism.
* **Anticipatory acumen:** The habit of looking a week or two ahead to spot calendar crunches, prep gaps, or logistical conflicts before they become problems.
* **Discretion and judgment:** High integrity and sound judgment when handling sensitive business and financial matters.
* **Independent judgment:** Able to balance competing priorities across multiple senior executives, exercise sound judgment, and proactively resolve conflicts with minimal direction.
* **Comfort with technology:** Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, and similar tools, with an interest in learning new systems.
* **Collaborative mindset:** Enjoys working with others, is willing to jump in where needed, and approaches challenges with a positive, can-do attitude.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* We expect this role's base salary to be $67,000 - $75,000 commensurate with the candidate's experience.
* Eligible for a bonus program.
* Comprehensive benefits.

You will act as an extension of the CEO, providing a combination of strategic, operational and administrative support. You will have visibility across the business, work closely with senior leadership and key stakeholders, and help ensure that priorities are translated into action.

The ideal candidate is highly intelligent, commercially minded, exceptionally organized and proactive. They have outstanding judgement, understand how to operate in a fast-paced executive environment and are confident making decisions, solving problems and managing sensitive situations with discretion.

**Key Responsibilities**  
  
Strategic Partnership & CEO Support

* Proactively manage the CEO’s time, ensuring focus remains on the most important business objectives.
* Anticipate the CEO’s needs, identify potential challenges and take action before issues arise.
* Prepare the CEO for key meetings, decisions and engagements, ensuring they have the right information, context and briefing materials.
* Exercise independent judgement in managing competing demands and determining what requires the CEO’s attention.

Business Operations & Executive Coordination

* Act as a central coordination point between the CEO and the senior leadership team.
* Drive follow-up on key business initiatives, strategic projects and executive priorities.
* Ensure important decisions are documented, communicated and progressed.
* Support the coordination of leadership meetings, executive offsites, board meetings and strategic planning sessions.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

* Manage communications on behalf of the CEO, drafting correspondence, presentations, briefing notes and executive communications.
* Understand the importance, context and sensitivity of different relationships and communications.
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion.

Executive Office & Information Management

* Manage the CEO’s inbox, identifying priorities, filtering requests and ensuring important matters receive appropriate attention.
* Prepare agendas, briefing packs, presentations, reports and other executive materials.
* Ensure the CEO has visibility of key developments, emerging issues and important business matters.
* Maintain effective systems for tracking commitments, priorities, decisions and follow-up actions.

Calendar, Travel & Logistics Management

* Own and proactively manage the CEO’s complex calendar, balancing strategic priorities, internal meetings and external commitments.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including itineraries, accommodation, transport and meeting logistics.
* Anticipate logistical challenges and proactively develop contingency plans.
* Manage expenses, invoices and administrative requirements associated with the CEO’s office.

Special Projects & Strategic Initiatives

* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives requiring input from multiple departments.
* Support business planning, organizational initiatives and strategic priorities.
* Step into emerging priorities and challenges, providing flexibility and support wherever the CEO needs it most.

**Skills, Experience & Attributes**

We are looking for someone who combines exceptional executive support skills with commercial awareness, emotional intelligence and a strong sense of ownership.

**Experience**

* Significant experience supporting a CEO, Founder, President or other senior executive in a complex, fast-paced business environment.
* Experience managing complex priorities, sensitive information and multiple competing demands.
* Demonstrable experience coordinating projects and driving actions through to completion.

**Core Skills**

* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of business priorities.
* Excellent judgement, discretion and decision-making ability.
* Highly proactive, resourceful and solutions oriented.
* Ability to synthesize complex information and communicate it clearly.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant business productivity tools.

We are seeking a **Project Coordinator & Scheduler** to join our Atlanta Home Theater team! This position is full-time and will be based out of the AHT home office in Roswell, GA.

* Build and maintain the installation calendar across multiple active projects, assigning crews by skill set, location and hours from the engineers' proposals

* Schedule punch-list visits, final walkthroughs and project closeouts

**Athletics & Aquatics Program Coordinator**  
**Parks & Recreation**

JOB SUMMARY
  
This position is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all aquatic programming and athletics/sports programs within the division. The position develops and delivers programs that meet community needs, supervises related program staff and activities, and serves as the primary liaison for youth athletic teams and competitive events, working collaboratively with the Aquatics Operations Coordinator and Aquatics Facility Coordinator.
  
  
MAJOR DUTIES
  
1. Recruits, interviews, hires, trains, schedules, and evaluates seasonal and part-time program instructors, seasonal program and other assigned personnel.
  
2. Plans, coordinates, and implements aquatic programs, including swim lessons, fitness classes, recreational swim, special events, and seasonal programming.
  
3. Plans, coordinates, and supervises athletics and sports programs, including youth and adult leagues, clinics, camps, and related activities.
  
4. Develops and implements new aquatic and athletic programs and initiatives to meet community needs and increase participation.
  
5. Serves as the primary sponsor and point of contact for youth athletic teams and athletes competing at Georgia Recreation and Parks Association (GRPA) aquatics and athletics events, including required travel and onsite supervision at competitions.
  
6. Recruits, trains, and provides functional direction to program instructors, coaches, and seasonal program staff in coordination with the Aquatics Operations Coordinator.
  
7. Ensures program activities comply with applicable safety standards, department policies, and governing body rules (including GRPA and relevant athletic associations).
  
8. Coordinates program schedules, facility usage requests, and equipment needs with the Aquatics Facility Coordinator and Operations staff.
  
9. Prepares program reports, participation statistics, and evaluation data; assists with related budget recommendations.
  
10. Supports marketing and outreach efforts by developing program descriptions, registration materials, and seasonal promotional content.
  
11. Provides customer service support related to program registration, schedules, rules, and participant feedback.
  
12. Performs other duties as assigned in support of the Parks and Recreation Department.
  
  
KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED BY THE POSITION
  
1. Knowledge of aquatic program planning, instruction, and delivery.
  
2. Knowledge of athletics and sports program administration, rules, and best practices.
  
3. Knowledge of computers and job-related software programs.
  
4. Knowledge of customer service techniques.
  
5. Knowledge of water safety protocols and instructional methods.
  
6. Knowledge of basic marketing and promotional practices.
  
7. Knowledge of Lifeguard, Water Safety Instructor, and related certification requirements.
  
8. Knowledge of GRPA and relevant athletic governing body rules and procedures.
  
9. Skill in math and grammar.
  
10. Skill in interpersonal relations.
  
11. Skill in oral and written communication.
  
12. Skill in scheduling and record keeping.
  
  
SUPERVISORY CONTROLS
  
The Athletics & Aquatics Manager assigns work based on general instructions. The supervisor spot-checks completed work for compliance with procedures, accuracy, and the nature and propriety of the final results.
  
  
GUIDELINES
  
Guidelines include American Red Cross Lifeguard, CPR, First Aid & AED standards; GRPA and relevant athletic association rules; department program policies; the Americans with Disabilities Act; and related city, state, and/or federal mandates or guidelines. These guidelines require judgment, selection, and interpretation in application.
  
  
COMPLEXITY/SCOPE OF WORK
  

* The work consists of varied program planning, supervisory, and coordination duties. Competing priorities across aquatic and athletic program areas and the need to balance community demand with available resources contribute to the complexity of the position.
* The purpose of this position is to plan and deliver high-quality aquatic and athletic programs that provide opportunities for residents of all ages. Success in this position contributes to increased participation and positive community engagement through recreation programming.

  
CONTACTS
  

* Contacts are typically with department employees, the Athletics & Aquatics Manager, Aquatics Operations Coordinator, Aquatics Facility Coordinator, youth league organizations, coaches, instructors, Community Center staff, Event Coordinator, outside vendors, and members of the general public.
* Contacts are typically to provide services, to give or exchange information, and/or to motivate.

  
PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ WORK ENVIRONMENT
  

* The work is typically performed while intermittently sitting, standing, or stooping. The employee frequently lifts light and heavy objects, climbs ladders, distinguishes between shades of color, and must be able to swim competently to complete life-saving techniques when required.
* The work is typically performed in an office, in a noisy place, or outdoors, occasionally in cold or inclement weather. The employee may be exposed to contagious or infectious diseases or irritating chemicals. The work may require the use of protective devices such as masks, goggles, and gloves.

  
SUPERVISORY AND MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITY
  
This position has functional supervision over assigned facility attendants and concession staff during operational hours. Functional supervision typically involves the ability to assign, coordinate, and review the quality and quantity of work of other employees.
  
  
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Baccalaureate degree in a course of study related to the occupational field required; and
* More than three years of related experience in aquatics pro

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Flexible schedule

**Inside Sales Rep, Founding Memberships (Sandy Springs, GA)**  
  
Full-time or part-time. $15-16/hour plus $10 per founding membership you sign. Start as soon as possible.  
  
We're opening a brand new Scenthound in Sandy Springs, and we need someone to fill it with members before the doors open.  
  
**WHO WE ARE**  
Scenthound isn't your everyday grooming shop. We focus on dog health and wellness, not just haircuts. Our membership model gives dogs routine care for their Skin, Coat, Ears, Nails and Teeth (S.C.E.N.T.). Our team runs six Scenthound locations across metro Atlanta, and Sandy Springs will be our seventh.  
  
Our North Star: we enrich the connection between people and their dogs.  
Our values: Dog First. One Pack. Bring Love. Seek Growth. Make A Difference.  
  
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
This is our first hire for Sandy Springs, and one of the most important. Before we open, you'll turn interested dog owners into founding members. Every member you sign is a dog we'll care for on day one, and a strong opening sets the store up for years. Once we open, you'll welcome the members you signed and keep selling memberships alongside the store team.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**  

* Call and text new leads fast, and walk them through a founding membership
* Follow up with people who aren't ready yet until they're a yes or a clear no
* Teach dog parents why routine wellness care matters, so the membership makes sense to them
* Get out in the neighborhood: local businesses, apartment communities, dog parks and events
* Sign members up and keep their profiles clean in our booking system
* Track your numbers each week and share what's working
* After we open: book appointments, run check-in and check-out, handle the cash drawer, and keep members happy and active

  
**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**  

* Hundreds of founding members signed by opening day, with you leading the charge
* Every lead gets a quick follow-up on every day you work
* Members who show up for their first visit and stay

  
**WHERE THIS CAN GO**  
Do this well, and you can help build our inside sales team, a central team that books and sells memberships for all our Atlanta stores, with room to lead it as we grow. Or move into Assistant Manager or Scenter Manager at Sandy Springs.  
  
**SCHEDULE**  
Full-time or part-time. Flexible shifts between 8 AM and 7 PM, Monday through Sunday. You won't work every day, but you'll need some evenings and weekends, since that's when dog owners pick up the phone.  
  
**WHO YOU ARE**  
You're outgoing and goal-driven, you follow up without being reminded, and a no doesn't ruin your day. You love dogs and want to grow into leadership.  
  
**Required:**  

* At least 1 year in a sales job with a goal to hit. Membership, gym, salon, retail, phone or inside sales all count.
* Customer service experience in retail, restaurants or similar
* Comfortable with phones, tablets and booking or point of sale software
* Available some evenings and weekends
* Reliable transportation to Sandy Springs
* Willing to work in a smoke-free environment

  
**Nice to have:**  

* Membership or subscription sales experience
* Experience with a CRM
* Knowledge of dog health and wellness

  
**PAY AND PERKS**  

* $16 per hour, plus $10 for every founding membership you personally sign, with no cap
* Merit-based pay increases
* Paid time off for eligible team members
* Free monthly membership for your dog
* A clear path into management

The Learning Center Operations Coordinator provides essential administrative, operational, and classroom support to ensure the effective daily functioning of Indelible Impressions Learning Center. **Position Title:** Community Outreach Specialist – Family Connects Chicago (FCC) Community Alignment – West Region

**Department:** Foster Care

**About the Program:**

The Family Connects Chicago (FCC) Community Alignment System strengthens the ecosystem of supports for birthing people and newborns by improving hyperlocal outreach, referral coordination, and community voice in neighborhoods experiencing the greatest disparities in infant mortality and maternal health outcomes. UCAN will serve as the Community Alignment Delegate for the West Region, embedding FCC within trusted West Side networks. The program advances CDPH’s four objectives: (1) outreach in priority areas; (2) systems improvement to strengthen referral pathways; (3) community engagement to elevate parent voice; and (4) coordination to ensure a unified citywide system. UCAN’s established trauma-informed infrastructure in North Lawndale and Garfield Park allows immediate implementation. The program formalizes navigation and alignment activities that UCAN already performs, ensuring that families identified through FCC nurse home visits are successfully connected to behavioral health, housing supports, food access, safe sleep resources, and other essential services.
