jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Account Executive or Client Services Supervisor (Account Lead)

**Role Type:** Hybrid Account Support & Job Trafficker

**Time Allocation:** 50% Job Workflow (Traffic) | 40% Client Admin | 10% Financial Support

**Position Summary:**

The Account Coordinator serves as the operational hub for their assigned account team. In this integrated role, you are responsible for both the administrative health of the client relationship and the end-to-end job trafficking of non-digital solutions engagements. You act as the bridge between Client Services and other teams, ensuring that work is scoped, scheduled, routed, and delivered on time and error-free.

Account Coordinators love the details. They want to know how things work and want to make sure they always work the way they are supposed to. An Account Coordinator at HDMZ is an entry-level position but it's a role that has a big impact on our success everyday. Account Coordinators love to collaborate, learn about our clients’ businesses and customers, build relationships with clients, embrace processes, are always curious and feel a heightened sense to not let others down. Account Coordinators have a passion for life sciences, marketing and the creative process that only an Agency environment can bring. Must be intelligent. And fun. And effective. No divas or delicate egos, please.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with internal and external partners to ensure all client requests are completed in a timely manner
* Manage the team status reports, meeting agendas and contact reports, and update them on a regular basis
* Create and build presentations for client meetings
* Responsible for daily traffic, job opening and management
* Implement and manage projects and related tasks
* Proofing and QA
* To be curious about how to solve problems in a way that respects the objective to be achieved as well as the client/agency relationship
* Be a champion for the agency and for the client by knowing how to navigate the messy human relationships that can cause conflict if not careful

**Responsibility detail:**

* **Job Traffic & Workflow (The "Traffic" Role)**

  + **Schedule Ownership:** **Create and manage daily timelines for print, branding, and content projects. You are responsible for knowing exactly where every job is for the client team you support.**
  + **Routing & Quality Control:** **Own the internal routing process. Ensure all creative work is reviewed by the appropriate leads (Strategy, Creative, Scientific) before it reaches the Client Supervisor or Account Lead.**
  + **Asset Management:** **Act as the central librarian for project assets. proactively gather and organize high-res logos, images, and copy decks so the creative team has everything they need before they start working and ensure they’re archived and available via the approved agency platforms and drives.**
  + **Vendor Coordination:** **Work with Account Leads and Dept Heads to manage specifications and deadlines for external vendors (printers, trade show partners), ensuring files are released correctly and on time.**
* **Client Administration & Support**

  + **Meeting Management:** **Own the logistics for all internal and client meetings. Most importantly, capture and distribute Contact Reports (meeting minutes) within 24 hours, clearly identifying "next steps" and action items for the team.**
  + **Client Correspondence:** **Draft routine client updates, timeline alerts, and file deliveries under the supervision of the Account Lead.**
  + **Presentation Support:** **Assist in building and formatting slide decks for client presentations, ensuring they match agency brand standards.**
* **Financial Hygiene**

  + **Budget Tracking:** **Work hand in hand with the Account Lead to monitor and track billable activity to budget.**

**What you are not responsible for:**

* **Technical PM:** You do not manage complex digital builds (websites/apps). These are handled by the COO/Digital PM.
* **Strategic Planning**: You support the strategy, but you do not write the strategic briefs or annual plans.
* **Staffing Allocation:** You request resources, but you do not make the final decision on who works on the project (that sits with the Team Lead and Account Lead).

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree (preferred in the sciences)
* Agency internship experience is strongly preferred.
* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail
* Strong communication skills, able to speak and write clearly and persuasively.
* Relationship builder
* Aptitude for learning new skills (both technical and organic) and procedures.
* Self-motivated with strong follow-through
* Adaptable to change and able to multitask
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Docs, Slides, Sheets, Forms)

jobs.title: Entry Level Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
***Launch Your Sales Career at Bisnow | 2027 BDR Class | July 5 Start***

***Bisnow is opening early recruitment for our 2027 Business Development Representative class — hiring hungry, high-potential candidates across multiple major US markets for a July 5, 2027 start date.***  
  
***We welcome upcoming Spring 2027 graduates, recent graduates, and early-career professionals with 0–1 years of experience from any background in sales. No prior real estate experience required — just strong communication skills, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in B2B media sales.***  
  
***This is a first job that becomes a career. You’ll partner with clients across the commercial real estate industry, be in the room at 400+ live events a year, and follow a clear path from BDR to Business Manager in a culture that genuinely promotes from within***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.

We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Competitive compensation structure
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Maternity and paternity leaves
* 401K
* Flexible Spending Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Health Savings Account
* **Unlimited Vacation Days**
* 7 days paid sick leave
* 9 paid Holidays
* Referral Bonus Program
* You’ll get to work with incredibly smart, passionate, driven, ambitious, kind, caring and mindful people and will rarely experience an overload of policies, bureaucracy or toxicity (the latter, we do not tolerate).

Uncapped monthly bonuses tied to a performance-based step scale: the more you close, the more you earn.

Anticipated start date: July 5th, 2027

new_jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  
  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  
  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  
  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

  

We’re looking for an ***Account Manager, VaaS*** who will run a large book of smaller and newer Vault-as-a-Service (VaaS) partners. You'll get them to live fast on a standard playbook, keep them healthy and spot the ones ready to grow. You're accountable for each account's revenue and retention.

  

*What VaaS is:*

PSA Vault stores graded cards for their owners. Vault-as-a-Service (VaaS) lets other companies build on it. Marketplaces, live-commerce apps, pack and break platforms, games and fantasy apps, fintechs and retailers use our APIs to store cards, transfer ownership between their customers and ship cards to a customer's door. They get vaulting and fulfillment without building a warehouse. The program went live in 2026, and new partners signed most weeks.

  

*Your book:*

You'll manage smaller partners on our standard rate card, plus new partners until they scale, across every part of the hobby. Expect many accounts, a light touch on each and repeatable launches. Your starting book is set when you join and rebalanced each quarter.

  

You’ll report to the *General Manager, VaaS* . ***Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered.*** ***We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.***

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Fast, standard launches.** Take each account from BD at signature, run the handoff and get the partner live on our standard onboarding playbook with as little custom work as possible.
* **Onboarding playbook.** Improve the onboarding playbook, self-serve materials and partner documentation as you go, so launches take less time.
* **Revenue and renewals.** Own revenue, renewals and expansion for your book within our standard pricing. Keep a health score for every partner.
* **Contract terms.** Know each account's pricing, minimums and SLAs, and hold both sides to them.
* **Forecasting.** Flag partner launches and campaigns to Vault Operations early, with a volume estimate.
* **Escalations.** Own the partner side of every issue: triage, updates and the SLA clock. Vault Operations, Product and Support fix the problem; you make sure it gets fixed and keep the partner informed.
* **Moving accounts up.** When a partner outgrows the standard tier, hand it to a Senior AM with an account plan.
* **Coverage.** Cover the Senior AMs' accounts during absences and peak periods.

*What you won't own:*

* Prospecting and closing new partners. BD does that.
* Billing and collections. Finance runs them; you own invoice accuracy and step in when an account falls behind.
* Fixing operational issues. Vault Operations does; you own the partner side.
* Custom deals. Anything outside standard terms goes to a Senior AM or the GM.

*Your first 90 days:*

* **Days 1–30:** learn the vault end to end (intake, imaging, ownership transfer, withdrawal, claims). Shadow the Senior AMs. Take over your book with a handoff on every account.
* **Days 31–60:** launch your first partners on the standard playbook. Put a health score on every account.
* **Days 61–90:** ship one improvement to the playbook or partner docs that cuts launch time. Flag the first accounts ready to move up a tier.

*What a typical week looks like:*

* Kickoffs and launch check-ins with new partners
* Answering partner questions in Slack and email, and routing issues to the right team
* Health-score review across your book
* Account notes in the CRM and a weekly update to the GM

*How we'll measure success:*

* Partners launched per quarter, and time from signature to first revenue
* Net and gross revenue retention for your book
* Accounts moved up a tier
* Overdue receivables

*Who you'll work with:*

Senior Account Managers, Business Development, VaaS Product & Engineering, Vault Operations, PSA Offers and Finance.

  

**Who You Are:**

*Required Qualifications:*

* 3–5 years in account management, customer success, partner operations or SaaS onboarding
* Experience running a high-volume book of B2B accounts (dozens at once)
* A clear writer who's comfortable with technical documentation and basic API concepts
* An eye for early signs that a partner is ready to grow or likely to leave
* You're skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) and use them to get more done: research an account, analyze us

The MPS Dean's Diversity Office initiates, implements, and evaluates efforts and conducts research on student, postdoc, and faculty success in the mathematical and physical science fields with an emphasis on ensuring fair access and equitable outcomes. This position is responsible for providing programmatic, administrative, and financial coordination for MPS Dean's Office. Provides support to the Assistant Dean. MPS Scholars is the official student success and mentorship program of the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, offered collaboratively with the Departments of Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Open to all intended and declared MPS majors, MPS Scholars provides opportunities to build community, explore academic and career pathways, and thrive throughout the Berkeley experience.
  
  
Since launching in Fall 2022, thousands of students have participated in MPS Scholars through mentorship, events, workshops, and academic and career resources.
  
  
MPS Scholars is a structured program, supported by funding from the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation. It provides activities and opportunities such as: A supportive mentoring network of advanced students, faculty, professional scientists, and alumni. Welcome and orientation programs for incoming students. Research and internship opportunities in academic and industry settings. Career development workshops, courses, networking events, and graduate school preparation. Academic resources designed to support success in MPS majors. Retreats, social events, and community-building activities that connect students with peers, graduate mentors, staff, alumni, and faculty across the MPS departments.
  
  
The Mathematical and Physical Sciences Scholarship Program (MPSSP) awards up to $15,000 per year in scholarship support to eligible students in Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Funded by the National Science Foundation's S-STEM program, MPSSP scholars receive financial support while participating fully in the MPS Scholars community.
  
  
At the graduate level, a bridge grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation grant is focused on establishing a prototype for the establishment of a Sloan Center for Systemic Change (SCSC) at Berkeley by establishing a consortium of departments working together to advance their equity goals.
  
  
At the postdoctoral level, the Postdoc Study, supported by a grant from the Heising-Simons Foundation, is designed to provide a clearer understanding of the experiences of postdoctoral scholars and causes of patterns of career selection among postdocs in the MPS fields at top-tier universities and national research facilities.

**About the Agency:**

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.

As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

**Your Team**

The FOIL Administrative Coordinator will be a member of the Public Information team within the agency’s Office of Compliance & Risk Management (CRM). This office includes various compliance, oversight, and hearing functions to ensure fairness, consistency, and equity in both our external and internal engagement. CRM collaborates with programs across HPD to ensure the agency and its partners comply with laws (federal, state, and city), regulatory requirements, policies, and procedures. The Office includes the following Divisions and units:

· Compliance & Strategy

· Economic Opportunity & Regulatory Compliance

· Audit Support

· Adjudications

· Public Information

HPD’s Public Information team is dedicated to serving the public by collaborating with internal partners and governing entities to facilitate access to agency information. The team promotes accountability, transparency, and compliance by:

· Establishing robust infrastructure within the agency to improve record retention and quality;

· Ensuring fair and secure access to agency records and materials for members of the public; and

· Safeguarding sensitive information by setting and maintaining best practices around data privacy and effective record management.

**Your Impact**

As a member of the Public Information team in CRM, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will support transparency and public access to information relating to HPD’s mission to provide secure and safe housing in New York City.

**Your Role**

Reporting under general supervision of the Deputy Records Access Officer and FOIL and the eDiscovery Specialist on a dedicated project basis, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will support the agency’s Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) program, working with the FOIL team on a segment of its redaction portfolio. Working in coordination with offices throughout the agency, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will gain an understanding of the different types of work done by the agency, develop relationships with people throughout HPD, and apply their customer service skills.

The records involved in this project will include, but not be limited to, Complaint Records, Violation Records, and Regulatory Agreements. All activity will be conducted under FOIL supervision.

**Your Responsibilities**

The FOIL Administrative Coordinator will be trained and instructed on requirements and software involved in the following duties:

· Search and retrieve responsive documents from specific agency and/or City websites

· Redact responsive records documents using Adobe Pro software

· Submit redacted documents to the FOIL team for review

· Enter completed FOILs information in an excel spreadsheet

· Assist with obtaining documents from program areas

· Review documents provided by agency personnel to ensure that the FOIL responses are accurate and complete

**Clinical Research Coordinator I** will oversee multiple clinical trials, investigator-initiated studies, and quality improvement projects within the Department of Neurology and support the Department's programs, serving as a point person for patients, their family members and the clinical study team. The position consists of working with various departments across the hospital, including forging new partnerships with departments to ensure completion of trial-related activities. The Clinical Research Coordinator I will direct participants and study team members to adhere to the study protocol and rules and regulations as governed by regulatory bodies including Institutional Review Boards and the FDA.

  

Under general supervision duties will include:

• Directing seamless flow of daily trial-related activities, recruitment and clinical assessments of the study subjects

• Directing strict adherence to the study protocols, as well as sponsor, FDA and other regulatory authority requirements.

• Designs and implements workflows for clinical trials, including reminders/updates to the clinical team

• Coordinating team members to complete both clinical and non-clinical assessments per protocol. This includes developing workflow for patient care such as assigning secretaries to schedule patients, developing workflow with ancillary departments (such as radiology, advanced imaging, pathology, pharmacy), and assigning appropriate clinical team members such as doctors to complete clinical tasks such as reviewing adverse events versus assigning non-clinical team members to complete non-clinical tasks such as administering questionnaires to a patient.

• Executing IRB submissions (event reporting, study status change etc.)

• Executing patient billing in multiple databases including the patient's electronic medical record.

• Developing action plans for ensuring all study tasks are completed as required per the protocol and developing subsequent corrective action plans if any errors are made.

• Coordinating appointments, procedures, and related services, and supporting financial activities.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I will be trained to be highly specialized in clinical trials assigned to them. The Clinical Research Coordinator I is expected to be able to manage clinical trial projects independently after sufficient training is completed.

  

**Essential Functions**

• Escalates issues related to clinical trial conduct to PI and senior research staff.

• Assigns training to the PI and other research team members for protocol amendments, and any other study required training.

• Screens and consents patients and ensures the scheduling and completion of assessments for ongoing study visits as dictated by the protocol.

• Schedules and coordinates appointments, procedures, and related services; records documentation, communications, and related information in the electronic medical record and other systems.

• Serves as a point of contact for patients, providers, sponsors, vendors, and other internal and external parties.

• Collects required data and imaging and ensures data entry into EDCs/Databases and image upload to imaging portals.

• Develops and executes multifaceted recruitment strategies by blending creative patient outreach with technical workflow integration and cross-departmental partnerships to optimize subject identification and enrollment.

• Oversees the quality of data provided to sponsor, escalates quality issues to the site manager.

• Maintains accurate records of study participants while safeguarding the confidentiality of subjects, as necessary.

• Maintains essential documents per FDA, Regulatory bodies, and sponsor requirements in the Regulatory Binder. This includes preparation of essential documents for the assigned clinical study.

• Provides ready access to patient binders and regulatory binders to the PI, Sponsor and/or Regulatory Authorities for assigned clinical trials.

• Coordinates and carries out monitoring visits and audits for assigned clinical trials.

• Collaborates with appropriate institutional review board to ensure approval of the clinical trial (renewal), approval of study documents (renewal, modification, notification) and personnel.

• Assists management with collection of updated essential documents and certifications for site personnel and sends these to sponsor as requested.

• Participates in Site Initiation Visit.

• Processes, packages, stores and ships clinical specimens as required by the protocol.

• Responsible for device accountability, ordering and storage of investigational products and/or lab kits.

• Prepares correspondence, reports, meeting materials, and minutes; maintains, organizes, and archives records in accordance with institutional, sponsor, and regulatory requirements; and maintains inventory of supplies and equipment and coordinates with vendors.

• Provides administrative and operational support to the Department as needed and performs other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**

• BS Required

• OHS Annual Assessment Required

• OHS Fit Test Required

• CITI Good Clinical Practice Certification, CITI Research with Biomedical Drugs and Devices Certification, CITI Dan gerous Goods and Biospecimen Handling Certification.

• Experience in clinical research, clinical trials and/or any medical related profession Preferred

This position will be based at a Department of Neurology campus, with occasional travel to other Montefiore locations as needed.

**RxSight® is an ophthalmic medical technology corporation headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California that has commercialized the world’s first and only adjustable intraocular lens (IOL) that is customized after cataract surgery. The company’s mission is to revolutionize the premium cataract surgery experience by allowing surgeons to partner with their patients to achieve optimized results for every unique eye.**

**OVERVIEW:**

The Account Manager (AM) is the sales lead for RxSight business in the defined territory and owns territory performance. The AM drives LAL growth by building trusted relationships with surgeons and practice staff, positioning premium technology to expand adoption, and optimizing patient flow to unlock practice capacity. This role executes the direction set by the Area Sales Director, translating the area's strategic priorities into territory activities and keeping growth initiatives aligned to them. AMs lead strategic customer engagement through data-driven account plans, regional referral strategies, and direct collaboration with the CS team to execute on site-level growth opportunities within the territory.

This role includes ongoing territory business planning and site-specific business reviews. AMs are expected to provide strategic and tactical execution in a structure primarily focused on LAL adoption, implementing clear processes that support same-store-sales growth as a core team function. AMs gather customer data to identify current and future opportunities at the practice level, guiding business resource allocation by geography and territory trends. The AM is expected to influence LAL penetration and same-store sales by managing cross-functional coordination and acting as a trusted business partner to the practice.

**This is a field-based position covering the New Jersey/New York area of the United States. This role will be based in** **Northern NJ or NYC or Long Island. Regular local travel is required to support customers and team members throughout the region so candidates must reside in or near those cities.**

* Commercial and sales acumen, with the ability to build and execute account-level growth strategy that drives LAL adoption and same-store growth.

new_jobs.title: Channel Account Manager, Partner Sales - VAR Channel
new_jobs.description:
**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

### **Summary**

Smarsh is seeking a high-performing Channel Account Manager to drive growth across our Value-Added Reseller (VAR) ecosystem in the United States. This role sits within our Capture organization and plays a critical part in expanding the reach of Smarsh’s compliance and capture solutions through strategic partner engagement.

Reporting to the Director of Partner Sales – Americas, this individual will be responsible for developing new distribution channels, accelerating partner led revenue, and building a predictable, scalable pipeline. Success in this role requires strong channel leadership, executive engagement, and the ability to align cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional partner and customer outcomes.

### **How will you contribute?**

* Own and exceed sales quota through VAR partners, driving both new customer acquisition and expansion within existing accounts.
* Develop and execute partner growth strategies to expand distribution and increase market penetration.
* Build and manage a predictable sales pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting and consistent execution.
* Engage and influence partner sales teams, delivering training, enablement, and joint go-to-market execution.
* Drive deal lifecycle management, including deal registration, conflict resolution, and opportunity progression.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, supporting partners on customer engagements and solution positioning.
* Lead account planning and mapping initiatives, aligning partner efforts to strategic priorities and high-value opportunities.
* Collaborate cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Operations, Finance) to ensure seamless post-sale execution and customer success.
* Negotiate and manage partner agreements, ensuring profitable and scalable commercial structures.
* Maintain CRM excellence (Salesforce) with accurate forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and communication tracking.
* Support financial accuracy, including partner invoice reconciliation and revenue alignment.
* Deliver product demonstrations and presentations, operating effectively in both sales and technical discussions.
* Build executive-level relationships within partner organizations to drive long-term strategic value.

### **What Success looks like...**

* Consistent achievement (and overachievement) of quota through partner-led sales.
* Expansion of high-performing VAR relationships and onboarding of new strategic partners.
* Increased partner engagement, enablement, and joint selling effectiveness.
* Seamless collaboration across internal teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

### **What will you bring?**

* Proven success in channel sales, partner management, or indirect sales models, preferably in SaaS, telecom, or compliance solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale VAR partnerships and drive partner led revenue growth.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels and engage with C-Suite leaders.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles, negotiations, and partner agreements.
* Proficiency in Salesforce and pipeline management best practices.
* Ability to operate as both a strategic leader and hands-on contributor in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable presenting and demonstrating solutions in customer and partner settings.

### **What do we offer?**

* Healthcare insurance: We provide medical, dental, and vision insurance, and a flexible spending account that allows you to set aside pre-tax dollars to pay for eligible out-of-pocket expenses.
* Personal time off: A healthy work-life balance is critical to your success at the office. Smarsh offers a “take-what-you-need” time off policy as well as flexible work arrangements.
* 401K Match: Smarsh provides a 4% 401K match for which employees are fully vested on day one.
* Sabbatical: The Smarsh sabbatical programme provides a time to recharge, study or simply do something you are passionate about away from the workplace. Employees are eligible after six years of service.
* Recognition: We’re big on kudos for a job well done. Our employee-recognition programme enables co-workers to nominate their peers who best embody our core values for recognition.

The above **salary range** represents Smarsh's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible base compensation at the time of posting. ***Any applicable bonus programs will be discussed during the recruiting process.***

The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training.

Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer.

**About our culture**

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best

new_jobs.title: U.S. Digital Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

* **Contract type:** Permanent, Full-time
* **Reports to:** Head of Digital Partnerships & Distribution – London *(dotted line to Head of U.S. Marketing & Fan Activation)*
* **Location:** Premier League Offices, New York City, USA

**Overview**

The Premier League has established an in-market presence to accelerate fan and commercial growth across the U.S. With the U.S. being a key priority market for the Premier League, there is significant focus on driving acquisition and engagement of fans. To help with this growth, the league is seeking to recruit a Digital Marketing Manager to work across the Premier League’s digital marketing and fan development operations in the U.S.

This exciting new role will report into the Head of Digital Partnerships & Distribution, and collaborate with global digital, content, marketing, events and broadcast teams. This role will also work across the broader business to understand the Premier League’s opportunities to help drive U.S. progress.

This role will manage and support on opportunities to grow and broaden the Premier League’s U.S. audience across the League’s owned and operated ecosystem – resulting in stronger and deeper fan engagement not only for the Premier League, but also with our Clubs, broadcast and commercial partners.

The ideal candidate will have a mix of experiences in performance marketing, CRM growth, digital product marketing and paid media. The ideal candidate should have an affinity for sports, be well-versed in digital marketing and consider themselves a self-starter.  
  
**Who we are**  
The Premier League is home to some of the most competitive and compelling football in the world. The League and its Clubs use the power and popularity of the competition to inspire fans, communities and partners in the UK and across the world. The Premier League brings people together from all backgrounds. It is a competition for everyone, everywhere and is available to watch in over 1.2 billion homes in 189 countries.

We have a wide variety of responsibilities. These include organizing the competition and its Handbook as well as managing the centralized broadcast and commercial rights. The work we do in conjunction with the Clubs also goes far beyond the 90 minutes. We support and provide a framework for youth development, we protect the organisation’s intellectual property, support the wider game and community programmes, undertake international development work and liaise with governing bodies and other leagues.

Our hybrid-working model also allows you some variety on your place of work, offering you the chance to work from home on some days each week. Where possible, you will attend the office or site visits in line with our company policy. All staff liaise closely with their line manager to manage their time appropriately and according to their work and team requirements.

### **The role**

The U.S. Digital Marketing Manager will act as the day-to-day point of contact with the global Digital Partnerships and Distribution team. The role will be responsible for the following in collaboration with the U.S. team, and global digital, and audience development teams:

**Performance Marketing & Fan Acquisition**

* Collaborate with global Digital team to plan, execute, and optimize local paid marketing campaigns across digital channels.
* Manage acquisition budgets and media agencies to deliver growth against defined KPIs.
* Continuously test creative, audience segments, messaging, and landing pages to improve performance.
* Develop audience acquisition strategies focused on attracting new Premier League fans across the U.S.

**First-Party Data & CRM Growth**

* Coordinate execution of initiatives designed to increase fan registrations, first party data capture, and CRM database growth.
* Manage campaigns and journeys supporting fan identification and record acquisition.
* Partner with product, analytics, and CRM teams to improve conversion funnels and registration experiences.
* Ensure data collection programs comply with applicable privacy regulations and Premier League standards.

**Lifecycle Marketing**

* Support and execute end-to-end fan lifecycle programs across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other owned channels.
* Build audience segmentation strategies to increase engagement, retention, and reactivation.
* Deliver automated campaigns to drive repeat engagement with Premier League digital products and content.

**Fantasy Premier League & Digital Product Marketing**

* Develop and execute season-long marketing campaigns supporting Fantasy Premier League and App growth in the U.S.
* Drive awareness, acquisition, retention, and engagement for Fantasy Premier League and other digital fan products.
* Collaborate with product, content, creative, and social teams to deliver integrated campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to increase participation and engagement throughout the football season.
* Collaborate with product team to identify product enhancement opportunities.
* Day to day management of U.S. digital hub. Collaborate with Content and Marketing teams to develop season-long content and promotional plan.

**Analytics & Insights**

* Monitor campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations.
* Track and report on key metrics, including:

o Customer acquisition cost (CAC).

o Cost per registration (CPR).

o Conversion rates.

o Engagement and retention metrics.

o Lifetime value indicators.

* Create regular performance reports and executive summaries for stakeholders.
* Leverage data and market insights to inform optimization strategies.
* Manage delivery of regular data and insights reporting to track KPI performance in collaboration with global digital & agencies.  
    
  **Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with U.S. marketing, digital, audience development, product, analytics, broadcast and commercial teams. Coordinate with external agencies and platform partners.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Background**

We’re a tech startup building better industrial equipment monitoring technology. As a data company, relentless accuracy underlies everything we do, and will be the foundation of our outbound sales motion.

**The Role**

We’re looking for creative and ambitious sales reps to join our team in the months following our Series A. You’ll be joining us just in time to set the groundwork for exponential growth over the coming years. This won’t be a standard entry-level sales role where you’ll step into an established system with close guidance.

We know that mass email blasts and generic templates don’t work in this field. Because of this, you will have to be open-minded, willing to fail, and eager to tackle hard problems with persistence. The role will focus on bringing strong leads into the pipeline through thoughtful outbound sales efforts.

We’re also not your typical SaaS company. Having a hardware component to the product will require you to cultivate connections with a wider range of people than if you were selling SaaS only. You’ll talk to everyone from discerning executives concerned with high-level business problems to maintenance technicians looking to save time in the machine room. Building the credibility you’ll need to do well will take time, but will be the groundwork for growing into a top level AE. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to talk.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build relationships with the engineering team to learn what makes our product so special, starting with the people who build it.
* Research target industries to create customized outreach strategies and prospect lists.
* Prospect, engage, and qualify leads through outreach strategies: cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and whatever other channels you believe in.
* Take personal ownership of the top of the funnel process, continuously improving strategies and experimenting with new approaches that you can share with the broader team.
* Collaborate closely with the sales and marketing teams to keep your outreach fresh and on brand.
* Build credibility with industry leaders by being insightful, genuinely curious, and overprepared.
* Schedule discovery meetings between qualified prospects and the rest of the team.
* Take detailed notes on customer feedback to share with the product and leadership teams.
* Be militant about tracking your work in our CRM.
* Charge towards KPIs (appointments set, opportunities created, etc.) and actively contribute to revenue goals. Don’t be afraid to reach out when you’re struggling.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Have 0-1+ years of sales experience ideally in a startup or similarly fast paced role, with a track record of building strong pipelines.
* Take deep personal ownership of your work product and relationships with your teammates.
* Communicate so effectively you inspire prospects to make time for you.
* Are habitually curious and driven by understanding how things work and how they can be improved.
* Ask questions aimed at connecting with people and solving their problems.
* Are able to meet ambiguity with ambition and meticulous attention to detail.

**Compensation**

* Total compensation: $85,000–$100,000 OTE (On-Target Earnings)
* Base salary: $60,000–$70,000
* Commission: $25,000–$30,000

We anticipate this role transitioning into an AE role within the first 12 months of hitting targets. Our AE compensation structure is built to reward selling and is uncapped with large quotas of >20% for closed ACV.

If interested in applying, please send a resume, along with any relevant work samples, and a brief (few sentences) statement about why our company interests you to careers@knaq.io.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative, Architecture & Design
new_jobs.description:
About MICRO:

MICRO is a premium architectural finishes company specializing in microcement systems. We supply and install decorative finishes for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects across North America. We control everything from product supply to certified installation, so quality and accountability stay consistent on every project. We train our certified installers in-house, and are available on Material Bank.

The role:  
We're looking for a motivated, design-savvy Sales Representative who loves building real relationships with the architecture and design community. You'll grow and manage a portfolio of accounts in your territory, open new business, and work closely with our Sales Manager to expand MICRO's presence in the market.

This isn't a transactional sales job. Our process is consultative: you'll work with designers and architects over weeks or months to get MICRO specified on projects, then support the client through installation and completion.

What you'll do:  
- Find and develop new business in your assigned territory  
- Build strong relationships with architects, interior designers, general contractors, and developers  
- Present MICRO's products, capabilities, and installation process to clients and specifiers  
- Get MICRO specified in project documents at the design development stage  
- Manage an active pipeline from first contact to signed contract  
- Run site visits, client meetings, and showroom presentations  
- Deliver and follow up on sample requests promptly  
- Attend industry events, trade shows, and networking functions  
- Keep accurate, up-to-date records in HubSpot CRM  
- Work with the Sales Manager and operations team to make project delivery seamless  
- Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets

What we're looking for:  
- 2 to 5 years of sales experience, ideally in architecture, interior design, construction, or luxury materials  
- Existing relationships in the design and build community (a strong plus)  
- Specification or consultative selling experience (preferred)  
- Familiarity with construction, building materials, or decorative finishes  
- CRM experience, HubSpot preferred  
- Ability to read architectural drawings and design specifications  
- Confident presenting to senior designers, architects, and project stakeholders  
- Strong organization across many projects and follow-ups at once  
- Self-motivated and comfortable working independently  
- Patient with long sales cycles and relationship-based selling  
- A genuine passion for design, interiors, and premium finishes, and a polished, professional presence

What we offer:  
- Competitive base salary plus commission  
- Territory ownership: build your own book of business  
- Room to grow with a fast-scaling premium brand  
- Ongoing product training and professional development  
- Support from an experienced Sales Manager and operations team  
- Access to a curated sample library and the Material Bank platform  
- A collaborative, design-forward team

How to apply:  
Apply through Indeed with your resume and a short cover letter on your relevant experience and why you'd be a great fit for MICRO. Questions can go to Ashley Hilton, Sales Manager, at ashley.h@micro-finishes.com.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**About the Position**

Silver Lining Homecare, a Licensed Home Care Services Agency (LHCSA), is seeking an experienced Business Development Representative / Account Manager to expand our referral network and grow our Bronx territory.

The ideal candidate has established connections within the Bronx’s senior-care industry and a proven ability to turn professional relationships into qualified referrals and admissions. This field-based position combines community outreach, relationship building, account management, and coordination with our intake team.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain relationships with hospital social workers, discharge planners, rehabilitation centers, nursing homes, senior living communities, senior centers, care managers, elder law attorneys, and other referral partners.
* Use existing Bronx connections to introduce our services and develop new referral opportunities.
* Identify key contacts within each account and strengthen relationships across social work, administration, nursing, and activities departments.
* Conduct regular account visits and schedule lunch-and-learns, educational presentations, and community events.
* Represent Silver Lining at networking events, health fairs, and professional meetings throughout the Bronx.
* Educate referral sources and families about our homecare services, coverage areas, and payment options.
* Work closely with intake to track referrals, address barriers, and support timely starts of care.
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, outreach, account activity, referrals, and follow-up tasks.
* Meet monthly referral and start-of-care goals and provide regular pipeline updates to leadership.
* Identify partnership opportunities and connect decision-makers with leadership for contracting discussions.

**Qualifications**

* Previous business development, account management, sales, or community outreach experience in homecare, healthcare, hospice, senior living, or a related field.
* Demonstrated success generating referrals and developing professional accounts.
* Familiarity with homecare services and senior-care referral pathways; knowledge of Medicaid, MLTC, and private-pay services preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage a territory, and meet measurable goals.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout the Bronx and attend occasional evening and weekend events.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role?**

We are looking for someone who enjoys being active in the community, builds trust through consistent follow-up, and can translate connections into referrals and admissions. You should be comfortable developing new accounts, strengthening existing relationships, and collaborating with intake to help families access care.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: On the road

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant New
new_jobs.description:
**Role overview**
-----------------

Newlab is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant to support our Global Head of Business and SVP of Operations.

This is an opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys keeping things organized, solving problems, and helping busy teams operate effectively. You'll play an important role in managing schedules, coordinating meetings and travel, tracking follow-ups, and making sure the day-to-day details are taken care of so our leaders can focus on their highest priorities.

You'll work closely with two senior leaders and collaborate with colleagues across Newlab's locations and functions, gaining exposure to a fast-moving business working at the intersection of technology, industry, and economic development.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and eager to learn. We're looking for someone who takes pride in being helpful, follows through on commitments, and brings a positive, solutions-oriented approach to their work.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Executive Support & Calendar Management**

* Manage day-to-day scheduling and calendars for Emilie and Dan, ensuring their time reflects their most important business priorities.
* Help prioritize incoming meeting requests, protect focus time, and ensure schedules are organized around key commitments.
* Look ahead to anticipate scheduling conflicts, upcoming meetings, travel needs, and other logistical considerations.
* Serve as a friendly and responsive point of contact for internal and external stakeholders coordinating with the executives.
* Develop a strong understanding of priorities, proactively identifying competing demands, escalating time-sensitive decisions, and ensuring appropriate attention is given to the highest-impact initiatives.

### **Meeting Coordination, Preparation & Follow-Through**

* Schedule regular team meetings, project reviews, and recurring check-ins across the commercialization and finance/operations groups.
* Coordinate pre-meeting preparation: follow up with meeting owners to ensure agendas, presentations, and background reading are ready and distributed well in advance.
* Identify when a team member needs a quick pre-alignment conversation with Emilie or Dan before a broader review, and get it on the calendar.
* Track meeting outcomes, capture clear next steps, and follow up with team members on their action items to keep projects moving.
* Maintain visibility into key executive commitments, decisions, and follow-ups across meetings, correspondence, and ongoing initiatives, proactively flagging items requiring attention or escalation.

### **Administrative support and logistics**

* Book travel arrangements and build clear, detailed travel itineraries.
* Organize logistics for internal team gatherings, reviews, and occasional offsites.
* Prepare and submit monthly expense reports.
* Serve as an approachable, organized point of contact for colleagues looking to connect with Emilie and Dan.
* Support executive correspondence, including triage, drafting routine communications, coordinating responses, and flagging time-sensitive matters requiring executive attention.

**Qualifications and qualities**
--------------------------------

* **Relevant experience:** Proven experience in an administrative support or executive assistant role, with a track record of supporting busy leaders.
* **Project management mindset:** Highly organized and process-oriented. Able to track multiple moving pieces, coordinate project reviews, and ensure tasks do not slip through the cracks.
* **Diplomatic assertiveness:** Comfortable managing up, nudging colleagues for overdue prep materials, and holding people accountable to deadlines with tact, warmth, and professionalism.
* **Anticipatory acumen:** The habit of looking a week or two ahead to spot calendar crunches, prep gaps, or logistical conflicts before they become problems.
* **Discretion and judgment:** High integrity and sound judgment when handling sensitive business and financial matters.
* **Independent judgment:** Able to balance competing priorities across multiple senior executives, exercise sound judgment, and proactively resolve conflicts with minimal direction.
* **Comfort with technology:** Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, and similar tools, with an interest in learning new systems.
* **Collaborative mindset:** Enjoys working with others, is willing to jump in where needed, and approaches challenges with a positive, can-do attitude.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* We expect this role's base salary to be $67,000 - $75,000 commensurate with the candidate's experience.
* Eligible for a bonus program.
* Comprehensive benefits.

With a presence in more than 80 countries, Steve Madden operates across wholesale, retail, e-commerce, licensing, and private label businesses. new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator & Scheduler
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a **Project Coordinator & Scheduler** to join our Atlanta Home Theater team! This position is full-time and will be based out of the AHT home office in Roswell, GA.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain the installation calendar across multiple active projects, assigning crews by skill set, location and hours from the engineers' proposals
* Rebuild the schedule quickly when a home isn't ready, a builder slips, a client reschedules or a technician is out, and communicate changes before crews arrive on site
* Hold weekly two-to-three-week look-ahead check-ins with builders and superintendents to confirm construction phases (rough-in, trim, finish)
* Confirm dates with clients ahead of each visit, working with our Design Ambassadors
* Run a readiness check before dispatch: site ready, equipment staged by the warehouse, payment milestone met, client confirmed
* Keep a backup list of work (prewires, warehouse and showroom work) so crews stay productive when a job falls through
* Send a daily dispatch summary so every installation technician knows tomorrow's job, crew, site contact and equipment
* Stay in sync with our Service Manager so installation and service schedules don't conflict
* Coordinate crew travel for out-of-state projects with our travel agent
* Track PTO on the schedule and follow up on technician time entries and daily job notes
* Schedule punch-list visits, final walkthroughs and project closeouts
* Report weekly on jobs completed as scheduled versus rescheduled, and why, and support our monthly projected-vs-actual labor hours review
* Keep project records current in our software (ProjX360 and Daylite)

**Requirements**

* Highly organized: keeps a clean, accurate system with nothing falling through the cracks, and can show you how they do it
* A natural puzzle-solver: enjoys fitting many moving pieces together and finding a workable answer fast when the pieces change
* Ready to take ownership quickly: able to learn our crews, builders and projects in the first few weeks and confidently run the schedule
* 3+ years of scheduling, dispatch or project coordination for field crews where schedules change constantly
* Proven ability to juggle multiple projects and re-plan quickly without losing track of details
* Confident, professional communicator by phone and email with homeowners, builders and superintendents, and able to deliver bad news early and clearly
* Strong follow-through; owns the calendar and keeps everyone working from the same plan
* Comfortable with scheduling or project-management software, and quick to learn new systems
* Excellent Excel / Google Sheets and Outlook / Google Calendar skills
* Available to start before December 1

**Desired Skills**

* Understanding of residential construction phases and how builders sequence trades
* Experience with field-service or construction software (ServiceTitan, BuilderTrend, Procore, Jobber, Housecall Pro, or similar)
* Exposure to luxury residential, custom homes, low-voltage, AV or smart-home work (helpful but not required)
* Experience coordinating travel or out-of-town crews

**Atlanta Home Theater (AHT)** is an award-winning luxury home cinema and smart home company with 30 years of experience. Founded in 1996 and based in a 12,000-square-foot design center and showroom in Roswell, Georgia, AHT designs, engineers and builds private cinemas, golf, racing and flight simulators, and fully automated homes with intelligent lighting, shades, audio and security. AHT was the youngest company ever named CEDIA Dealer of the Year, and has also won CEDIA awards for Best Home Theater and Best Showroom. We serve discerning homeowners and custom home builders across greater Atlanta and the United States. Some reasons to join AHT are:

* **Our vision**: Entertainment Done Right. We exist to create the world’s most extraordinary experiences at home. Every room we build is designed in the client’s style, engineered to disappear, tuned for perfection and felt in every seat.
* **Our craft**: We pair luxury design with advanced technology and handle every project from start to finish. Our design engineers, technicians and programmers take each room from first sketch to final calibration.
* **Our team**: We’re a close-knit team that likes to be challenged. We invest in training and new tools so our people can do their best work and grow with the company.
* **Our clients**: Our work is built on craftsmanship and long-term trust with homeowners, builders and designers. Many have trusted us for decades and keep referring us to others.
* **Our growth**: We’re expanding in greater Atlanta and growing our client base across the U.S. That means more opportunities to work on the most exciting projects in our industry.

=============

GEM Technologies, Inc. (GEM) is an award-winning federal contractor with more than 30 years of experience providing environmental, construction, facility management, and technical services to federal agencies, state and local governments, and commercial organizations. Founded in 1994 as a nuclear engineering firm to support federal operations in East Tennessee, GEM has since expanded into a nationwide, multi-disciplinary provider with over 270 employees and a diverse portfolio of contracts in the environmental, nuclear, and defense sectors. Some reasons to join GEM are:

* *Our philosophy* – We believe in the power of effective collaboration and recognize that good partnerships are the building blocks to success.

Description:

***Protomiq Named No. 3165 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 List, the Most Prestigious Ranking of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies***

At Protomiq, we believe that the auto dealerships that win are the ones that create better experiences for their customers. That's why we build technology that helps dealers connect with shoppers, turn interest into action, and drive measurable business results. Thousands of dealerships across North America rely on Protomiq's solutions to engage customers, improve performance, and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving market. From independent dealerships to some of the largest dealer groups and automotive brands in the industry, Protomiq is trusted by dealerships focused on what comes next. This is a strategic, go-to-market position responsible for integrating events and field marketing into Protomiq’s demand and pipeline generation, sales, account-based marketing, and brand strategies. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong execution skills. The Protomiq Event Marketing Manager owns event strategy and execution and field marketing programs that help meet the company’s monthly demand and pipeline generation goals.

* Plan, execute and measure trade show involvement, including large national shows and smaller regional events

* Strong financial and analytical skills, including budget management, investment prioritization, performance analysis, and ROI measurement.
* Experience negotiating sponsorships, vendor agreements, venues, and event services.
* Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder-influence skills.

**Travel**

* Approximately 25% including occasional evenings and weekends based on event schedule.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Events & Logistics Lead, Phoenix Deployment
new_jobs.description:
Job ID: 530508

CRH's Americas Materials division is the leading integrated supplier of aggregates, asphalt, ready mixed concrete and paving and construction services in North America. Our operations span North America with over 29,000 employees at close to 1,660 locations in 45 US States and 2 Canadian provinces.

  

**Job** **Summary**

CRH Americas Materials currently has ~15 different ERP systems (from two separate software vendors - SAP and Viewpoint) and is on a transformational journey, named Project Phoenix, to move to a single ERP environment (SAP) with standardized business processes across the company. This will be a multi-year program with complex change management and implementation plans. The transformation includes the integration or retirement of a full suite of approximately 30 legacy applications spanning finance, operations, safety, HR, environmental, and other functional areas as those business processes move onto SAP S/4HANA.

The Executive Assistant, Event & Logistics Lead plans and supports in-person events for Project Phoenix. Reporting to the VP, Assistant GM, Phoenix Deployment for the project, this role coordinates logistics for training, testing and validation meetings held in multiple waves across multiple locations in the US and Canada. The role will also support the Phoenix team with administrative needs between events.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, budget conscious and comfortable managing large groups, multiple vendors and last-minute changes. Exceptional attention to detail is critical to success in this role.

This is a project-based role with travel of 50% or more.

.

**Job Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Logistics

  

* Plan and coordinate in person events from start to finish, including training, testing and validation sessions.
* Source and manage hotels, venues, catering, AV and other vendors, and coordinate contract review and approval.
* Manage hotel room blocks, meeting space and event materials such as name badges, signage and supplies.
* Provide onsite support during events, including setup, check in and issue resolution.
* Partner with IT and AV teams to make sure technology is ready for each event.

Attendee Management & Communications

  

* Maintain accurate attendee lists and manage registration, confirmations and follow up.
* Partner with Business Unit leaders to confirm attendee lists and coordinate changes.
* Draft and send attendee communications, including invitations, logistics details, agendas and reminders.

Budget & Administration

  

* Track event spending against budget and look for ways to reduce costs.
* Review and process vendor invoices and expenses accurately and on time.

Project Phoenix Team Support

  

* Support the Project Phoenix team with administrative needs.

Full-time or part-time. $15-16/hour plus $10 per founding membership you sign. Start as soon as possible.  
  
We're opening a brand new Scenthound in Sandy Springs, and we need someone to fill it with members before the doors open.  
  
**WHO WE ARE**  
Scenthound isn't your everyday grooming shop. We focus on dog health and wellness, not just haircuts. Our membership model gives dogs routine care for their Skin, Coat, Ears, Nails and Teeth (S.C.E.N.T.). Our team runs six Scenthound locations across metro Atlanta, and Sandy Springs will be our seventh.  
  
Our North Star: we enrich the connection between people and their dogs.  
Our values: Dog First. One Pack. Bring Love. Seek Growth. Make A Difference.  
  
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
This is our first hire for Sandy Springs, and one of the most important. Before we open, you'll turn interested dog owners into founding members. Every member you sign is a dog we'll care for on day one, and a strong opening sets the store up for years. Once we open, you'll welcome the members you signed and keep selling memberships alongside the store team.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**  

* Call and text new leads fast, and walk them through a founding membership
* Follow up with people who aren't ready yet until they're a yes or a clear no
* Teach dog parents why routine wellness care matters, so the membership makes sense to them
* Get out in the neighborhood: local businesses, apartment communities, dog parks and events
* Sign members up and keep their profiles clean in our booking system
* Track your numbers each week and share what's working
* After we open: book appointments, run check-in and check-out, handle the cash drawer, and keep members happy and active

  
**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**  

* Hundreds of founding members signed by opening day, with you leading the charge
* Every lead gets a quick follow-up on every day you work
* Members who show up for their first visit and stay

  
**WHERE THIS CAN GO**  
Do this well, and you can help build our inside sales team, a central team that books and sells memberships for all our Atlanta stores, with room to lead it as we grow. Or move into Assistant Manager or Scenter Manager at Sandy Springs.  
  
**SCHEDULE**  
Full-time or part-time. Flexible shifts between 8 AM and 7 PM, Monday through Sunday. You won't work every day, but you'll need some evenings and weekends, since that's when dog owners pick up the phone.

You're outgoing and goal-driven, you follow up without being reminded, and a no doesn't ruin your day. You love dogs and want to grow into leadership.

* At least 1 year in a sales job with a goal to hit. Membership, gym, salon, retail, phone or inside sales all count.

**Nice to have:**  

* Membership or subscription sales experience
* Experience with a CRM
* Knowledge of dog health and wellness

* $16 per hour, plus $10 for every founding membership you personally sign, with no cap
* Merit-based pay increases
* Paid time off for eligible team members
* Free monthly membership for your dog
* A clear path into management

* Serve as a friendly, welcoming, and professional first point of contact for parents, visitors, and staff.

* Assist with administrative correspondence, filing, data entry, and maintaining accurate records.
* Support parent communications and distribute center announcements as directed.
* Maintain an organized, professional, and welcoming front office environment.

* Coordinate employee breaks and classroom relief coverage.

new_jobs.title: Account Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Account Executive or Client Services Supervisor (Account Lead)

**Role Type:** Hybrid Account Support & Job Trafficker

**Time Allocation:** 50% Job Workflow (Traffic) | 40% Client Admin | 10% Financial Support

**Position Summary:**

The Account Coordinator serves as the operational hub for their assigned account team. In this integrated role, you are responsible for both the administrative health of the client relationship and the end-to-end job trafficking of non-digital solutions engagements. You act as the bridge between Client Services and other teams, ensuring that work is scoped, scheduled, routed, and delivered on time and error-free.

Account Coordinators love the details. They want to know how things work and want to make sure they always work the way they are supposed to. An Account Coordinator at HDMZ is an entry-level position but it's a role that has a big impact on our success everyday. Account Coordinators love to collaborate, learn about our clients’ businesses and customers, build relationships with clients, embrace processes, are always curious and feel a heightened sense to not let others down. Account Coordinators have a passion for life sciences, marketing and the creative process that only an Agency environment can bring. Must be intelligent. And fun. And effective. No divas or delicate egos, please.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with internal and external partners to ensure all client requests are completed in a timely manner
* Manage the team status reports, meeting agendas and contact reports, and update them on a regular basis
* Create and build presentations for client meetings
* Responsible for daily traffic, job opening and management
* Implement and manage projects and related tasks
* Proofing and QA
* To be curious about how to solve problems in a way that respects the objective to be achieved as well as the client/agency relationship
* Be a champion for the agency and for the client by knowing how to navigate the messy human relationships that can cause conflict if not careful

**Responsibility detail:**

* **Job Traffic & Workflow (The "Traffic" Role)**

  + **Schedule Ownership:** **Create and manage daily timelines for print, branding, and content projects. You are responsible for knowing exactly where every job is for the client team you support.**
  + **Routing & Quality Control:** **Own the internal routing process. Ensure all creative work is reviewed by the appropriate leads (Strategy, Creative, Scientific) before it reaches the Client Supervisor or Account Lead.**
  + **Asset Management:** **Act as the central librarian for project assets. proactively gather and organize high-res logos, images, and copy decks so the creative team has everything they need before they start working and ensure they’re archived and available via the approved agency platforms and drives.**
  + **Vendor Coordination:** **Work with Account Leads and Dept Heads to manage specifications and deadlines for external vendors (printers, trade show partners), ensuring files are released correctly and on time.**
* **Client Administration & Support**

  + **Meeting Management:** **Own the logistics for all internal and client meetings. Most importantly, capture and distribute Contact Reports (meeting minutes) within 24 hours, clearly identifying "next steps" and action items for the team.**
  + **Client Correspondence:** **Draft routine client updates, timeline alerts, and file deliveries under the supervision of the Account Lead.**
  + **Presentation Support:** **Assist in building and formatting slide decks for client presentations, ensuring they match agency brand standards.**
* **Financial Hygiene**

  + **Budget Tracking:** **Work hand in hand with the Account Lead to monitor and track billable activity to budget.**

**What you are not responsible for:**

* **Technical PM:** You do not manage complex digital builds (websites/apps). These are handled by the COO/Digital PM.
* **Strategic Planning**: You support the strategy, but you do not write the strategic briefs or annual plans.
* **Staffing Allocation:** You request resources, but you do not make the final decision on who works on the project (that sits with the Team Lead and Account Lead).

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree (preferred in the sciences)
* Agency internship experience is strongly preferred.
* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail
* Strong communication skills, able to speak and write clearly and persuasively.
* Relationship builder
* Aptitude for learning new skills (both technical and organic) and procedures.
* Self-motivated with strong follow-through
* Adaptable to change and able to multitask
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Docs, Slides, Sheets, Forms)
